title: Harder Than the Task: From Technical to Organizational Difficulty in AI Benchmarking
title_zh: 比任务更难：AI基准测试中从技术难度到组织难度的跨越

paragraphs.en: Victor Barres 1 , Aden Barton 1 , Nicolai J. Foss 2 , Henrik M. Nielsen 2
paragraphs.zh: Victor Barres 1，Aden Barton 1，Nicolai J. Foss 2，Henrik M. Nielsen 2

paragraphs.en: Keywords: Artificial intelligence; AI benchmarking; organizational task difficulty; organizational coordination; organization design.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：人工智能；AI 基准测试；组织任务难度；组织协调；组织设计。

paragraphs.en: AI benchmarks have made remarkable progress in measuring the ability of AI systems to perform increasingly demanding cognitive and technical tasks. Yet, many of these benchmarks treat technical tasks as the unit of analysis, while much economically valuable work takes place within organizations, where tasks are embedded in a system of relations. Within organizations, successful task performance depends not only on solving the technical demands of the task but also on navigating the interdependence of activities, distributed knowledge, differentiated authority, temporal constraints, conflicting interests, and changing environmental conditions while the task is underway. Accordingly, we argue that organizational task difficulty constitutes a distinct and insufficiently recognized dimension of AI capability, and that existing approaches to benchmarking provide an incomplete basis for assessing how effectively AI agents can perform real-world organizational work. By drawing on organization theory, we develop a taxonomy of the structure of work that characterizes the conditions that agents face in organizational work. Applying this taxonomy to analyze existing benchmarks, we find limited and uneven coverage of organizational dimensions, with fewer than one quarter of prominent benchmarks claiming any of them. We therefore argue that AI benchmarks should increasingly move beyond the evaluation of technically difficult tasks toward the systematic assessment of agents’ ability to navigate the organizational conditions under which economically valuable work takes place.
paragraphs.zh: AI基准测试在衡量AI系统执行日益高要求的认知与技术任务的能力方面取得了显著进展。 然而，许多基准测试将技术任务作为分析单元，而大量具有经济价值的工作发生在组织内部，任务嵌入在一种关系系统之中。 在组织内部，成功的任务执行不仅取决于解决任务的技术要求，还取决于在任务进行过程中应对活动之间的相互依赖、分布式知识、差异化权威、时间约束、利益冲突以及不断变化的环境条件。 因此，我们主张，组织任务难度构成了AI能力的一个独特且未被充分认识的维度，而现有的基准测试方法为评估AI智能体执行真实组织工作的有效程度提供了不完整的基础。 通过借鉴组织理论，我们构建了一个工作结构分类法，用以刻画智能体在组织工作中面临的条件。 将该分类法应用于分析现有基准测试，我们发现组织维度的覆盖有限且不均衡，在知名基准测试中声称涵盖任一组织维度的不足四分之一。 因此，我们主张，AI基准测试应日益超越对技术难度高的任务的评估，转向系统性地评估智能体应对组织条件的能力，因为这些条件正是具有经济价值的工作发生的环境。

paragraphs.en: In the last few years, artificial intelligence models have made striking progress on benchmarks spanning many occupations, from coding to mathematics to law. These benchmarks are often taken as evidence of AI’s ability to do entire jobs and therefore are sometimes seen as leading indicators of worker automation or displacement ( Mazeika et al., 2025 ). But most AI benchmarks evaluate atomic tasks, whereas most economically valuable work is performed in organizations. That is not to say that AI models cannot perform organizational work, but rather that few benchmarks measure such organizational capability; as a result, most benchmarks fail to measure the tissue that aggregates technical tasks into a job.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去几年里，人工智能模型在涵盖从编程到数学再到法律等众多职业的基准测试中取得了惊人的进展。 这些基准测试常被视为人工智能能够胜任完整工作的证据，因此有时被认为是员工被自动化或取代的先行指标（ Mazeika et al., 2025 ）。 但大多数人工智能基准测试评估的是原子化任务，而大多数具有经济价值的工作是在组织中完成的。 这并不是说人工智能模型无法完成组织性工作，而是说很少有基准测试能衡量这种组织能力；因此，大多数基准测试无法衡量将技术任务聚合为一项工作的组织肌理。

paragraphs.en: Task difficulty and the difficulty of performing work inside an organization are not the same thing. Tasks are here understood as the foundational, microscopic units of work that combine to form jobs, roles, occupations, and entire organizational workflows. Work in organizations takes the form of workflows, and organization theory has long recognized that organizing work involves securing the conditions this work requires: managing the dependencies between tasks ( Thompson, 1967 ), drawing on knowledge dispersed across different actors ( Hayek, 1945 ), and relying on hierarchies that route problems to the right problem-solvers ( Garicano, 2000 ). A task may be technically straightforward once the relevant information, objective, and decision rights are specified, but such simplicity is often not present in organizations. Instead, much of the difficulty in organizational work arises from the surrounding structures rather than from the focal task in itself.
paragraphs.zh: 任务难度与在组织内部执行工作的难度并不是同一回事。 此处将任务理解为构成工作、角色、职业以及整个组织工作流程的基础性微观工作单元。 组织中的工作以工作流程的形式存在，而组织理论早已认识到，组织工作意味着为其创造所需条件：管理任务之间的依赖关系（Thompson, 1967），利用分散在不同行动者之间的知识（Hayek, 1945），以及依靠将问题导向合适的问题解决者的层级结构（Garicano, 2000）。 一旦相关信息、目标和决策权得以明确，一项任务在技术上可能是简单的，但在组织中这种简单性往往并不存在。 相反，组织工作中的许多困难来自于周边结构，而非焦点任务本身。

sents.zh: 任务难度与在组织内部执行工作的难度并不是同一回事。

paragraphs.en: Consider a task in which a human resources employee, following a merger, needs to determine the service date for a group of employees. The underlying task may be quite trivial, but the correct answer could depend on information distributed across a handbook, a merger agreement, an external consultant, a benefits administrator, and former employees. Some sources may be in conflict, certain information may be confidential, and a looming deadline makes the order of interactions important. Completing the task well, then, depends not only on calculating the correct date but also on understanding how the task is embedded in a structure of information, authority, and interdependence.
paragraphs.zh: 设想这样一个任务：合并之后，一名人力资源员工需要确定一批员工的入职服务日期。 底层任务可能相当简单，但正确答案可能取决于分散在员工手册、合并协议、外部顾问、福利管理员以及前员工那里的信息。 有些信息来源可能相互冲突，某些信息可能是保密的，而迫近的截止日期使得互动的先后顺序变得重要。 因此，要出色地完成这项任务，不仅需要计算出正确的日期，还需要理解该任务是如何嵌入在信息、权威与相互依赖的结构之中的。

sents.en: Consider a task in which a human resources employee, following a merger, needs to determine the service date for a group of employees.
sents.zh: 设想这样一个任务：合并之后，一名人力资源员工需要确定一批员工的入职服务日期。

sents.en: The underlying task may be quite trivial, but the correct answer could depend on information distributed across a handbook, a merger agreement, an external consultant, a benefits administrator, and former employees.

sents.zh: 有些信息来源可能相互冲突，某些信息可能是保密的，而迫近的截止日期使得互动的先后顺序变得重要。

paragraphs.en: We call the additional difficulty created by such organizational embedding organizational task difficulty , in contrast to technical task difficulty . Technical task difficulty arises from performing the focal transformation when the relevant objective, inputs, and authority to act are given. Organizational task difficulty arises when those inputs are not given and must be located, reconciled, or obtained from other activities and actors. The two can vary independently, where a technically demanding task may be organizationally simple, and a technically simple task can be organizationally demanding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种组织性嵌入所造成的额外困难称为「组织性任务难度」，以区别于「技术性任务难度」。 技术性任务难度源于在给定相关目标、输入和行动权限的情况下执行焦点转换。 组织性任务难度则产生于这些输入并非给定、而必须从其他活动和行动者那里定位、协调或获取的情况。 这两者可以独立变化：一项技术上要求很高的任务可能在组织上很简单，而一项技术上简单的任务也可能在组织上要求很高。

sents.en: We call the additional difficulty created by such organizational embedding organizational task difficulty , in contrast to technical task difficulty .
sents.zh: 我们将这种组织性嵌入所造成的额外困难称为「组织性任务难度」，以区别于「技术性任务难度」。

sents.en: Technical task difficulty arises from performing the focal transformation when the relevant objective, inputs, and authority to act are given.
sents.zh: 技术性任务难度源于在给定相关目标、输入和行动权限的情况下执行焦点转换。

sents.en: Organizational task difficulty arises when those inputs are not given and must be located, reconciled, or obtained from other activities and actors.
sents.zh: 组织性任务难度则产生于这些输入并非给定、而必须从其他活动和行动者那里定位、协调或获取的情况。

sents.en: The two can vary independently, where a technically demanding task may be organizationally simple, and a technically simple task can be organizationally demanding.
sents.zh: 这两者可以独立变化：一项技术上要求很高的任务可能在组织上很简单，而一项技术上简单的任务也可能在组织上要求很高。

paragraphs.en: The advent of AI colleagues, such as Claude Tag ( Anthropic, 2026 ), and personal AI agents, such as Meta’s Muse ( Meta, 2026 ), highlights how such agentic systems are increasingly capable of carrying out complex tasks on behalf of their users. Despite these advancements in AI capabilities, the economic effects observed so far have been more modest and uneven than what the pace of model development would suggest ( Acemoglu, 2025 ; Brynjolfsson et al., 2025 ). One potential explanation among several for this gap is the distinction between technical and organizational difficulty. Once implemented in organizations, AI agents must navigate interdependencies, information, and authority, which are not necessarily solved by scaling technical capabilities. At the same time, AI agents have shown notable capabilities to coordinate among themselves, forming systems that function as organizations in their own right ( Arrieta et al., 2026 ), sometimes with few or no humans involved. The OpenAI–Hugging Face incident in July 2026 illustrates this ability to coordinate at scale. Around 1,200 agents coordinated through an unsanctioned message board in an attempt to game how they were scored, which led to the breach of Hugging Face’s systems ( METR, 2026 ). This incident underscores the capabilities and risks introduced by AI agents, raising questions around the governance mechanisms when such AI capabilities are implemented in existing organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 Claude Tag（Anthropic，2026）这样的 AI 同事，以及诸如 Meta 的 Muse（Meta，2026）这样的个人 AI 智能体的出现，凸显了此类智能体系统日益有能力代表其用户执行复杂任务。 尽管 AI 能力取得了这些进展，但迄今为止观察到的经济效应比模型发展的速度所暗示的更为温和且不均衡（Acemoglu，2025；Brynjolfsson 等，2025）。 在多种可能的解释中，一个潜在的解释是技术难度与组织难度之间的区别。 一旦在组织中落地实施，AI 智能体必须应对相互依赖关系、信息与权威问题，而这些问题并不一定随技术能力的扩展而得到解决。 与此同时，AI 智能体已展现出显著的彼此协调能力，形成了本身就如同组织般运作的系统（Arrieta 等，2026），有时几乎或完全没有人类参与。 2026 年 7 月的 OpenAI–Hugging Face 事件印证了这种大规模协调的能力。 约 1200 个智能体通过一个未经许可的留言板进行协调，试图操纵对它们的评分方式，从而导致了 Hugging Face 系统遭到入侵（METR，2026）。 这一事件凸显了 AI 智能体带来的能力与风险，也引发了当此类 AI 能力被引入现有组织时治理机制应如何设计的问题。

paragraphs.en: Although AI agents are increasingly used in organizations, AI benchmarking lacks a vocabulary for describing the organizational conditions they face. Existing taxonomies provide rich frameworks for describing what work consists of. O*NET is one such taxonomy, providing a systematic classification of occupations ( Peterson et al., 2001 ). Recent studies have applied it to assess how large language models (LLMs) may affect occupations and the broader economy ( Eloundou et al., 2024 ; Felten et al., 2023 ; Mertens et al., 2026 ; see also Mercor, 2026 ). Yet, AI benchmarking lacks a taxonomy comparable to O*NET for describing the organizational conditions surrounding task performance. Further, improvements in technical task capability need not be accompanied by equivalent improvements in the ability to navigate the interdependencies, authority, and information structures of organizations. As a result, without such a taxonomy, AI benchmarks have no systematic way to characterize the organizational situations they represent, identify important situations they omit, or locate the sources of model success and failure.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管AI智能体在组织中的应用日益增多，但AI基准测试仍缺乏一套用于描述智能体所面临组织条件的词汇体系。 现有的分类学为描述工作内容提供了丰富的框架。 O*NET就是这样一个分类体系，它对职业进行了系统化分类（Peterson et al., 2001）。 近期研究已将其应用于评估大语言模型（LLM）可能如何影响职业及更广泛的经济（Eloundou et al., 2024；Felten et al., 2023；Mertens et al., 2026；另见Mercor, 2026）。 然而，AI基准测试缺乏一个可与O*NET媲美的分类体系，用于描述任务执行所处的组织条件。 此外，技术任务能力的提升未必伴随着在组织中的相互依赖、权威与信息结构中导航能力的同等提升。 因此，若没有这样一个分类体系，AI基准测试就无法系统性地刻画其所代表的组织情境、识别其遗漏的重要情境，或定位模型成功与失败的来源。

sents.en: Although AI agents are increasingly used in organizations, AI benchmarking lacks a vocabulary for describing the organizational conditions they face.
sents.zh: 尽管AI智能体在组织中的应用日益增多，但AI基准测试仍缺乏一套用于描述智能体所面临组织条件的词汇体系。

sents.en: Existing taxonomies provide rich frameworks for describing what work consists of.
sents.zh: 现有的分类学为描述工作内容提供了丰富的框架。

sents.en: O*NET is one such taxonomy, providing a systematic classification of occupations ( Peterson et al., 2001 ).
sents.zh: O*NET就是这样一个分类体系，它对职业进行了系统化分类（Peterson et al., 2001）。

sents.en: Recent studies have applied it to assess how large language models (LLMs) may affect occupations and the broader economy ( Eloundou et al., 2024 ; Felten et al., 2023 ; Mertens et al., 2026 ; see also Mercor, 2026 ).
sents.zh: 近期研究已将其应用于评估大语言模型（LLM）可能如何影响职业及更广泛的经济（Eloundou et al., 2024；Felten et al., 2023；Mertens et al., 2026；另见Mercor, 2026）。

sents.en: Yet, AI benchmarking lacks a taxonomy comparable to O*NET for describing the organizational conditions surrounding task performance.
sents.zh: 然而，AI基准测试缺乏一个可与O*NET媲美的分类体系，用于描述任务执行所处的组织条件。

sents.en: Further, improvements in technical task capability need not be accompanied by equivalent improvements in the ability to navigate the interdependencies, authority, and information structures of organizations.
sents.zh: 此外，技术任务能力的提升未必伴随着在组织中的相互依赖、权威与信息结构中导航能力的同等提升。

sents.en: As a result, without such a taxonomy, AI benchmarks have no systematic way to characterize the organizational situations they represent, identify important situations they omit, or locate the sources of model success and failure.
sents.zh: 因此，若没有这样一个分类体系，AI基准测试就无法系统性地刻画其所代表的组织情境、识别其遗漏的重要情境，或定位模型成功与失败的来源。

paragraphs.en: Our primary conceptual contribution addresses this gap. We develop a preliminary taxonomy that provides such a vocabulary for the classification of important organizational conditions surrounding task performance. Drawing on organization theory and organizational economics, we identify recurring features of organizational work, including the interdependence among activities, the distribution of information, the allocation of authority and decision rights, temporal dependencies, the alignment of interests, and changes in relevant conditions while work is underway.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心概念性贡献正是弥补了这一空白。 我们构建了一个初步的分类体系，为对任务执行所处的重要组织条件进行分类提供了这样一种词汇表。 基于组织理论与组织经济学，我们识别出组织工作中反复出现的特征，包括活动之间的相互依赖、信息的分布、权威与决策权的配置、时间上的依赖关系、利益的协调，以及工作推进过程中相关条件的变化。

sents.en: Our primary conceptual contribution addresses this gap.
sents.zh: 我们的核心概念性贡献正是弥补了这一空白。

sents.en: We develop a preliminary taxonomy that provides such a vocabulary for the classification of important organizational conditions surrounding task performance.
sents.zh: 我们构建了一个初步的分类体系，为对任务执行所处的重要组织条件进行分类提供了这样一种词汇表。

sents.en: Drawing on organization theory and organizational economics, we identify recurring features of organizational work, including the interdependence among activities, the distribution of information, the allocation of authority and decision rights, temporal dependencies, the alignment of interests, and changes in relevant conditions while work is underway.
sents.zh: 基于组织理论与组织经济学，我们识别出组织工作中反复出现的特征，包括活动之间的相互依赖、信息的分布、权威与决策权的配置、时间上的依赖关系、利益的协调，以及工作推进过程中相关条件的变化。

paragraphs.en: We structure the organizational embedding of work into four analytically related layers: structure of work, coordination requirements, governance mechanisms, and performance outcomes. Our taxonomy focuses primarily on the structure of work, namely the organizational conditions facing actors, human and AI alike. At a higher level, we also highlight the coordination requirements created by the structure of work, the mechanisms for addressing them, and the resulting performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将工作的组织嵌入结构化为四个在分析上相互关联的层次：工作结构、协调要求、治理机制与绩效结果。 我们的分类法主要聚焦于工作结构，即人类与AI智能体等行为者所面临的组织条件。 在更高的层面，我们还会强调由工作结构产生的协调要求、应对这些要求的机制，以及由此带来的绩效。

sents.en: We structure the organizational embedding of work into four analytically related layers: structure of work, coordination requirements, governance mechanisms, and performance outcomes.
sents.zh: 我们将工作的组织嵌入结构化为四个在分析上相互关联的层次：工作结构、协调要求、治理机制与绩效结果。

sents.en: Our taxonomy focuses primarily on the structure of work, namely the organizational conditions facing actors, human and AI alike.
sents.zh: 我们的分类法主要聚焦于工作结构，即人类与AI智能体等行为者所面临的组织条件。

sents.en: At a higher level, we also highlight the coordination requirements created by the structure of work, the mechanisms for addressing them, and the resulting performance.
sents.zh: 在更高的层面，我们还会强调由工作结构产生的协调要求、应对这些要求的机制，以及由此带来的绩效。

paragraphs.en: The taxonomy also creates a basis for asking what organizational conditions are actually captured by the benchmarks used to evaluate AI models. Aggregate benchmark scores can conceal systematic strengths and weaknesses of models when benchmarks combine heterogeneous organizational conditions without clearly identifying them. We therefore use the taxonomy to label the organizational coverage of existing AI benchmarks. In this analysis, we distinguish between the organizational features that are merely mentioned in benchmark descriptions, those that are claimed as part of the benchmark itself, and those that are measured separately in standalone results.
paragraphs.zh: 该分类框架还为进一步追问提供了基础，即用于评估 AI 模型的基准实际上捕捉了哪些组织条件。 当基准在未能明确识别各组织条件的情况下将其异质性地混合在一起时，汇总的基准得分可能掩盖模型系统性的优势与劣势。 因此，我们利用该分类框架来标注现有 AI 基准的组织覆盖范围。 在这项分析中，我们区分了仅在基准描述中被提及的组织特征、被声称作为基准本身一部分的组织特征，以及在独立结果中被单独测量的组织特征。

sents.en: The taxonomy also creates a basis for asking what organizational conditions are actually captured by the benchmarks used to evaluate AI models.
sents.zh: 该分类框架还为进一步追问提供了基础，即用于评估 AI 模型的基准实际上捕捉了哪些组织条件。

sents.en: Aggregate benchmark scores can conceal systematic strengths and weaknesses of models when benchmarks combine heterogeneous organizational conditions without clearly identifying them.
sents.zh: 当基准在未能明确识别各组织条件的情况下将其异质性地混合在一起时，汇总的基准得分可能掩盖模型系统性的优势与劣势。

sents.en: We therefore use the taxonomy to label the organizational coverage of existing AI benchmarks.
sents.zh: 因此，我们利用该分类框架来标注现有 AI 基准的组织覆盖范围。

sents.en: In this analysis, we distinguish between the organizational features that are merely mentioned in benchmark descriptions, those that are claimed as part of the benchmark itself, and those that are measured separately in standalone results.
sents.zh: 在这项分析中，我们区分了仅在基准描述中被提及的组织特征、被声称作为基准本身一部分的组织特征，以及在独立结果中被单独测量的组织特征。

paragraphs.en: With this labeling, we find that organizational conditions are largely absent from the benchmarks the field pays most attention to. Fewer than a quarter of the 522 prominent benchmarks we tag (118, or 23 percent) claim any of the six dimensions that constitute work’s organizational structure. And when organizational conditions appear, they are concentrated in a few forms. For example, authority most often takes the form of a written policy, information often requires reconciling documents, and work with colleagues is nearly absent. Such benchmarks may have realistic atomic tasks, which may be quite difficult technically, but the field has left organizational task difficulty largely unmeasured.
paragraphs.zh: 根据这一标注，我们发现该领域最关注的基准测试中几乎完全不涉及组织性条件。 在我们标注的522个知名基准测试中，仅有不到四分之一（118个，即23%）声称涵盖了构成工作组织结构的六个维度中的任何一个。 而当组织性条件出现时，它们又集中在少数几种形式上。 例如，权威最常以书面政策的形式出现，信息往往需要协调多份文档，而与同事协作的工作则几乎不存在。 这类基准测试可能包含现实中的原子化任务，这些任务在技术上可能相当困难，但该领域在很大程度上从未测量过组织性任务难度。

sents.en: With this labeling, we find that organizational conditions are largely absent from the benchmarks the field pays most attention to.
sents.zh: 根据这一标注，我们发现该领域最关注的基准测试中几乎完全不涉及组织性条件。

sents.en: Fewer than a quarter of the 522 prominent benchmarks we tag (118, or 23 percent) claim any of the six dimensions that constitute work’s organizational structure.
sents.zh: 在我们标注的522个知名基准测试中，仅有不到四分之一（118个，即23%）声称涵盖了构成工作组织结构的六个维度中的任何一个。

sents.en: And when organizational conditions appear, they are concentrated in a few forms.
sents.zh: 而当组织性条件出现时，它们又集中在少数几种形式上。

sents.en: For example, authority most often takes the form of a written policy, information often requires reconciling documents, and work with colleagues is nearly absent.
sents.zh: 例如，权威最常以书面政策的形式出现，信息往往需要协调多份文档，而与同事协作的工作则几乎不存在。

sents.en: Such benchmarks may have realistic atomic tasks, which may be quite difficult technically, but the field has left organizational task difficulty largely unmeasured.
sents.zh: 这类基准测试可能包含现实中的原子化任务，这些任务在技术上可能相当困难，但该领域在很大程度上从未测量过组织性任务难度。

paragraphs.en: Our paper makes three contributions. First, we distinguish technical task difficulty from organizational task difficulty, providing a way to conceptualize why rapidly improving performance of AI models on technically specified benchmarks may translate imperfectly into performance inside organizations. Second, we forward a preliminary taxonomy for representing the organizational dimensions of work, which is intended to offer a common language for benchmark construction, coverage assessment, and comparison. Third, we apply the taxonomy to existing AI benchmarks to assess organizational coverage. Taken together, these contributions suggest shifting the unit of AI evaluation from the isolated task toward the task as it is performed within organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的论文做出三点贡献。 首先，我们区分了技术性任务难度与组织性任务难度，为概念化以下问题提供了一种方式：为什么 AI 模型在技术性明确基准上快速提升的表现，可能无法完美地转化为组织内部的表现。 其次，我们提出了一套用于表征工作之组织维度的初步分类体系，旨在为基准构建、覆盖度评估与比较提供一种共同语言。 第三，我们将该分类体系应用于现有 AI 基准，以评估其组织覆盖度。 综合来看，这些贡献表明应将 AI 评估的单元从孤立的任务转向任务在组织内实际被执行时的形态。

sents.en: Our paper makes three contributions.
sents.zh: 我们的论文做出三点贡献。

sents.en: First, we distinguish technical task difficulty from organizational task difficulty, providing a way to conceptualize why rapidly improving performance of AI models on technically specified benchmarks may translate imperfectly into performance inside organizations.
sents.zh: 首先，我们区分了技术性任务难度与组织性任务难度，为概念化以下问题提供了一种方式：为什么 AI 模型在技术性明确基准上快速提升的表现，可能无法完美地转化为组织内部的表现。

sents.en: Second, we forward a preliminary taxonomy for representing the organizational dimensions of work, which is intended to offer a common language for benchmark construction, coverage assessment, and comparison.
sents.zh: 其次，我们提出了一套用于表征工作之组织维度的初步分类体系，旨在为基准构建、覆盖度评估与比较提供一种共同语言。

sents.en: Third, we apply the taxonomy to existing AI benchmarks to assess organizational coverage.
sents.zh: 第三，我们将该分类体系应用于现有 AI 基准，以评估其组织覆盖度。

sents.en: Taken together, these contributions suggest shifting the unit of AI evaluation from the isolated task toward the task as it is performed within organizations.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些贡献表明应将 AI 评估的单元从孤立的任务转向任务在组织内实际被执行时的形态。

paragraphs.en: Much economically valuable work takes place within organizations. As Coase (1937) noted, work is organized within firms, rather than among individuals trading through markets, because using the market to coordinate is costly for some activities, whereas within firms, work is instead directed by authority. Further, within firms, output depends on more than the execution of individual tasks. In this context, tasks are the foundational, microscopic units of work that combine to form jobs, roles, occupations, and workflows. Each task converts inputs into an output, such as goods and services ( Acemoglu & Autor, 2011 ). Within organizations, tasks form parts of systems of differentiated activities with interdependencies ( Thompson, 1967 ), and performance often depends on the actions, knowledge, and decisions of other actors. For example, a production engineer may require information that sits with the design department, require approvals from the finance department for procurement of parts, and depend on the engineer’s manager for the ultimate decision to execute the plan. Difficulty thus arises not only from the focal task in itself, but also from the relationships that connect it to other activities and actors.
paragraphs.zh: 许多具有经济价值的工作是在组织内部完成的。 正如科斯（Coase, 1937）所指出的，工作之所以在企业内部组织，而不是通过市场在个体之间交易，是因为对某些活动而言利用市场进行协调成本高昂，而在企业内部，工作则由权威来指挥。 此外，在企业内部，产出不仅取决于各项任务的执行。 在这一背景下，任务是工作的基础性、微观性单元，多个任务组合起来构成岗位、角色、职业和工作流程。 每个任务都将输入转化为输出，例如商品和服务（Acemoglu & Autor, 2011）。 在组织内部，任务是具有相互依赖关系的差异化活动体系的组成部分（Thompson, 1967），绩效往往取决于其他参与者的行动、知识和决策。 例如，一位生产工程师可能需要设计部门掌握的信息，需要财务部门对零部件采购的审批，并依赖工程师的经理做出执行计划的最终决定。 因此，困难不仅来自焦点任务本身，还来自将其与其他活动和参与者联系起来的各种关系。

sents.en: Much economically valuable work takes place within organizations.
sents.zh: 许多具有经济价值的工作是在组织内部完成的。

sents.en: As Coase (1937) noted, work is organized within firms, rather than among individuals trading through markets, because using the market to coordinate is costly for some activities, whereas within firms, work is instead directed by authority.

sents.zh: 此外，在企业内部，产出不仅取决于各项任务的执行。

sents.en: Each task converts inputs into an output, such as goods and services ( Acemoglu & Autor, 2011 ).
sents.zh: 每个任务都将输入转化为输出，例如商品和服务（Acemoglu & Autor, 2011）。

sents.en: Within organizations, tasks form parts of systems of differentiated activities with interdependencies ( Thompson, 1967 ), and performance often depends on the actions, knowledge, and decisions of other actors.
sents.zh: 在组织内部，任务是具有相互依赖关系的差异化活动体系的组成部分（Thompson, 1967），绩效往往取决于其他参与者的行动、知识和决策。

sents.en: For example, a production engineer may require information that sits with the design department, require approvals from the finance department for procurement of parts, and depend on the engineer’s manager for the ultimate decision to execute the plan.
sents.zh: 例如，一位生产工程师可能需要设计部门掌握的信息，需要财务部门对零部件采购的审批，并依赖工程师的经理做出执行计划的最终决定。

sents.en: Difficulty thus arises not only from the focal task in itself, but also from the relationships that connect it to other activities and actors.
sents.zh: 因此，困难不仅来自焦点任务本身，还来自将其与其他活动和参与者联系起来的各种关系。

paragraphs.en: The first source of difficulty is what we call technical task difficulty , which refers to the difficulty of performing the focal transformation when the relevant objective, inputs, and authority to act are given. It may arise from domain knowledge, reasoning requirements, the number of steps required, computational demands, or uncertainty embedded in the focal problem. Most of the existing AI benchmarks focus on tasks of this nature, such as with problems in coding, math, or reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种困难来源是我们所说的技术性任务难度，即在给定相关目标、输入和行动权限的情况下，执行焦点转换本身所面临的难度。 它可能源于领域知识、推理要求、所需步骤的数量、计算需求，或焦点问题中蕴含的不确定性。 现有的大多数AI基准测试都聚焦于此类任务，例如编程、数学或推理方面的问题。

sents.en: The first source of difficulty is what we call technical task difficulty , which refers to the difficulty of performing the focal transformation when the relevant objective, inputs, and authority to act are given.
sents.zh: 第一种困难来源是我们所说的技术性任务难度，即在给定相关目标、输入和行动权限的情况下，执行焦点转换本身所面临的难度。

sents.en: It may arise from domain knowledge, reasoning requirements, the number of steps required, computational demands, or uncertainty embedded in the focal problem.
sents.zh: 它可能源于领域知识、推理要求、所需步骤的数量、计算需求，或焦点问题中蕴含的不确定性。

sents.en: Most of the existing AI benchmarks focus on tasks of this nature, such as with problems in coding, math, or reasoning.
sents.zh: 现有的大多数AI基准测试都聚焦于此类任务，例如编程、数学或推理方面的问题。

paragraphs.en: The second source of difficulty, organizational task difficulty , arises when successful performance of the focal task depends on relationships with other activities or actors. Much of what goes on in organizations is based on relationships with other actors, which makes this source of difficulty relational. This difficulty can arise, for instance, when relevant information sits elsewhere, when another actor controls a required input, when decision rights sit with somebody other than the focal actor, or when actors have different objectives. Organizational task difficulty thus reflects the relationship dependencies surrounding the task rather than technical demands of the focal transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 第二类困难来源，即组织性任务难度，出现在焦点任务的成功执行依赖于与其他活动或行动者的关系时。 组织中发生的很多事情都基于与其他行动者的关系，这使得这一困难来源具有关系性。 例如，当相关信息掌握在别处、另一行动者控制着某项必需的投入、决策权归属于焦点行动者以外的某人，或各行动者目标不一致时，这种困难就可能出现。 因此，组织性任务难度反映的是任务周围的关系依赖，而非焦点转换的技术要求。

sents.en: The second source of difficulty, organizational task difficulty , arises when successful performance of the focal task depends on relationships with other activities or actors.
sents.zh: 第二类困难来源，即组织性任务难度，出现在焦点任务的成功执行依赖于与其他活动或行动者的关系时。

sents.en: Much of what goes on in organizations is based on relationships with other actors, which makes this source of difficulty relational.
sents.zh: 组织中发生的很多事情都基于与其他行动者的关系，这使得这一困难来源具有关系性。

sents.en: This difficulty can arise, for instance, when relevant information sits elsewhere, when another actor controls a required input, when decision rights sit with somebody other than the focal actor, or when actors have different objectives.
sents.zh: 例如，当相关信息掌握在别处、另一行动者控制着某项必需的投入、决策权归属于焦点行动者以外的某人，或各行动者目标不一致时，这种困难就可能出现。

sents.en: Organizational task difficulty thus reflects the relationship dependencies surrounding the task rather than technical demands of the focal transformation.
sents.zh: 因此，组织性任务难度反映的是任务周围的关系依赖，而非焦点转换的技术要求。

paragraphs.en: Organizational task difficulty is not just a reflection of the number of actors or interactions involved. Tasks with many actors may impose relatively modest coordination requirements if their activities are largely independent. Rather, it is the structure of dependencies connecting actors, activities, information, and decision rights that gives rise to such difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 组织性任务难度不仅仅是对所涉行动者或交互数量的反映。 如果行动者众多的任务中各方活动大体独立，其协调要求可能相对较低。 确切地说，正是连接行动者、活动、信息与决策权的依赖结构产生了这种难度。

sents.en: Organizational task difficulty is not just a reflection of the number of actors or interactions involved.
sents.zh: 组织性任务难度不仅仅是对所涉行动者或交互数量的反映。

sents.en: Tasks with many actors may impose relatively modest coordination requirements if their activities are largely independent.
sents.zh: 如果行动者众多的任务中各方活动大体独立，其协调要求可能相对较低。

sents.en: Rather, it is the structure of dependencies connecting actors, activities, information, and decision rights that gives rise to such difficulty.
sents.zh: 确切地说，正是连接行动者、活动、信息与决策权的依赖结构产生了这种难度。

paragraphs.en: These dependencies do not create a single, uniform source of difficulty. Instead, the difficulty is closely connected to the task at hand and the organizational context in which it is executed. Simply collapsing these conditions into a uniform category of organizational complexity fails to capture how different demands arise, such as from distributed information or the divergent interests of actors. An actor may be perfectly capable of acquiring and validating different information sources yet unable to balance the competing interests of others within the organization.
paragraphs.zh: 这些依赖关系并不构成单一的、统一的困难来源。 相反，这种困难与手头的任务以及执行任务所处的组织情境密切相关。 简单地将这些情形归入统一的组织复杂性类别，无法捕捉不同需求是如何产生的，例如来自分布式的信息或各智能体之间相互冲突的利益。 一个智能体可能完全有能力获取和验证不同的信息来源，却无法平衡组织内其他智能体的相互竞争的利益。

sents.en: These dependencies do not create a single, uniform source of difficulty.
sents.zh: 这些依赖关系并不构成单一的、统一的困难来源。

sents.en: Instead, the difficulty is closely connected to the task at hand and the organizational context in which it is executed.
sents.zh: 相反，这种困难与手头的任务以及执行任务所处的组织情境密切相关。

sents.en: Simply collapsing these conditions into a uniform category of organizational complexity fails to capture how different demands arise, such as from distributed information or the divergent interests of actors.
sents.zh: 简单地将这些情形归入统一的组织复杂性类别，无法捕捉不同需求是如何产生的，例如来自分布式的信息或各智能体之间相互冲突的利益。

sents.en: An actor may be perfectly capable of acquiring and validating different information sources yet unable to balance the competing interests of others within the organization.
sents.zh: 一个智能体可能完全有能力获取和验证不同的信息来源，却无法平衡组织内其他智能体的相互竞争的利益。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between technical and organizational task difficulty helps explain why certain relatively straightforward technical tasks may be difficult to complete within organizations. While both sources of difficulty are often present for the same task, the two can vary independently. A technically demanding task may be organizationally simple when the actor holds the relevant information, has the authority to act, and can perform the task without coordinating with others. Conversely, a task that is simple in its technical nature may be organizationally difficult when the information is distributed across multiple actors, when approvals must be obtained, or when successful completion depends on coordinating outputs with others. This independence implies that simplifying a technical task need not simplify the organizational setting in which it is performed, and vice versa. Figure 1 illustrates the four types of task that result.
paragraphs.zh: 技术性难度与组织性难度的区分有助于解释，为什么某些技术上相对简单的任务在组织内部却可能难以完成。 虽然这两种难度来源常常同时存在于同一任务中，但二者可以独立变化。 当执行者掌握相关信息、拥有行动权限，并且无需与他人协调即可完成任务时，一项技术要求很高的任务在组织层面可能是简单的。 相反，一项在技术性质上简单的任务，在信息分布于多个智能体之间、需要获得审批、或者成功完成取决于与他人协调产出的情况下，在组织层面可能是困难的。 这种独立性意味着，简化一项技术任务未必会简化其所在的执行环境，反之亦然。 图1展示了由此产生的四种任务类型。

paragraphs.en: The economics literature on technological change has similarly focused on tasks, although without explicitly distinguishing between their technical and organizational difficulty. In the task-based framework, jobs are seen as bundles of constituent tasks, and technologies can substitute for or complement particular tasks rather than occupations as a whole ( Acemoglu & Autor, 2011 ; Autor et al., 2003 ). This task-based framework has been applied to AI, because its unit of analysis maps onto occupational taxonomies, such as O*NET, which provide relatively standardized descriptions of activities across different occupations ( Brynjolfsson et al., 2018 ; Eloundou et al., 2024 ; Garicano et al., 2026 ). The framework is not limited to technical work, as O*NET task descriptions often have organizational content, such as coordinating the work of others, but the tasks are necessarily described as discrete units separate from the organizational structure in which they are performed.
paragraphs.zh: 关于技术变革的经济学文献同样聚焦于任务，只是没有明确区分任务在技术层面和组织层面的难度。 在基于任务的框架中，工作被视为由若干构成性任务组成的集合，技术可以替代或补充特定任务，而不是替代或补充整个职业（Acemoglu & Autor, 2011；Autor et al., 2003）。 这一基于任务的框架已被应用于人工智能（AI），因为其分析单元能够映射到职业分类体系（如 O*NET）上，而这类体系对不同职业的活动提供了相对标准化的描述（Brynjolfsson et al., 2018；Eloundou et al., 2024；Garicano et al., 2026）。 该框架并不局限于技术性工作，因为 O*NET 的任务描述通常包含组织层面的内容，例如协调他人的工作，但任务必然被描述为与其实施所处的组织结构相分离的离散单元。

paragraphs.en: Although the task-based perspective has not provided a clean separation between the technical and organizational components of work, adjacent research has underlined the economic importance of the capabilities associated with operating in organizational contexts. At the individual level, research has documented the substantial and increasing returns that are associated with social skills in labor markets ( Deming, 2017 ; Deming & Kahn, 2018 ; Edin et al., 2022 ; Weinberger, 2014 ). Similarly, such social skills have also been shown to predict group performance at a level that is comparable to measured intelligence ( Weidmann & Deming, 2021 ). Social skills are not equivalent to organizational capability, but this research suggests that economically valuable work depends on more than technical proficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管基于任务的视角尚未在工作的技术性成分与组织性成分之间提供清晰的划分，但相关研究已经强调了与在组织情境中开展运作相关的能力在经济上的重要性。 在个体层面，已有研究记录了劳动力市场中与社会技能相关的大量且不断上升的回报（Deming, 2017; Deming & Kahn, 2018; Edin et al., 2022; Weinberger, 2014）。 类似地，此类社会技能也被证明能够预测群体绩效，其预测水平可与实测的智力相当（Weidmann & Deming, 2021）。 社会技能并不等同于组织能力，但这一研究表明，具有经济价值的工作所依赖的不只是技术上的熟练。

sents.en: Although the task-based perspective has not provided a clean separation between the technical and organizational components of work, adjacent research has underlined the economic importance of the capabilities associated with operating in organizational contexts.

paragraphs.en: Similarly, studies highlight that management practices account for substantial variation in firm-level productivity ( Bloom & Van Reenen, 2007 ), and that improvements in such practices can contribute to sizable productivity gains ( Bloom et al., 2013 ). Related work emphasizes the economic importance of managerial quality for the productivity of workers and organizations ( Fenizia, 2022 ; Lazear et al., 2015 ). Taken together, the literature reinforces the broader point that productive performance depends not only on the ability to execute the focal task, but also on the way in which activities, information, and decisions are organized and coordinated.
paragraphs.zh: 同样地，有研究强调，管理实践在企业层面生产率的差异中占了很大比重（Bloom & Van Reenen, 2007），而此类实践的改进可以带来可观的生产率提升（Bloom et al., 2013）。 相关研究强调了管理者素质对劳动者和组织生产率的经济重要性（Fenizia, 2022；Lazear et al., 2015）。 综上所述，这些文献强化了一个更广泛的观点：生产绩效不仅取决于执行核心任务的能力，还取决于活动、信息和决策的组织与协调方式。

sents.en: Similarly, studies highlight that management practices account for substantial variation in firm-level productivity ( Bloom & Van Reenen, 2007 ), and that improvements in such practices can contribute to sizable productivity gains ( Bloom et al., 2013 ).
sents.zh: 同样地，有研究强调，管理实践在企业层面生产率的差异中占了很大比重（Bloom & Van Reenen, 2007），而此类实践的改进可以带来可观的生产率提升（Bloom et al., 2013）。

sents.zh: 综上所述，这些文献强化了一个更广泛的观点：生产绩效不仅取决于执行核心任务的能力，还取决于活动、信息和决策的组织与协调方式。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between technical and organizational task difficulty becomes particularly relevant as AI systems continue to improve. AI models may keep advancing on technically specified tasks, but if there are not corresponding improvements for organizational tasks, the productivity gains from such model advancements may be limited. Existing research has already documented heterogeneity in the productivity effects of generative AI ( Brynjolfsson et al., 2025 ), as well as outlined a “jagged technological frontier” of AI performance across tasks ( Dell’Acqua et al., 2026 ). One possible source of this heterogeneity is the organizational setting in which tasks are performed.
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能系统持续改进，技术性任务难度与组织性任务难度之间的区分变得尤为重要。 人工智能模型可能在技术性明确的任务上不断进步，但如果组织性任务没有相应的改进，此类模型进步带来的生产力收益可能有限。 现有研究已经记录了生成式人工智能在生产力效应上的异质性（Brynjolfsson et al., 2025），并勾勒出人工智能跨任务表现的“参差技术边界”（Dell’Acqua et al., 2026）。 这种异质性的一种可能来源是任务执行所处的组织环境。

sents.en: The distinction between technical and organizational task difficulty becomes particularly relevant as AI systems continue to improve.
sents.zh: 随着人工智能系统持续改进，技术性任务难度与组织性任务难度之间的区分变得尤为重要。

sents.zh: 这种异质性的一种可能来源是任务执行所处的组织环境。

paragraphs.en: In contrast to the organizational difficulty described above, AI benchmarking has largely developed around a task-based conception of capability. AI benchmarks are tests used to score models. A benchmark specifies a problem, provides or makes available the information required to address it, and evaluates the model’s response against some criterion of successful performance. Benchmarks serve two main functions, among others. First, they are a measurement tool, allowing researchers to compare systems on a common set of tasks ( Donoho, 2017 ). Second, they can set direction. Once something can be measured, labs can hill-climb on it and make it a priority, meaning that benchmarks can shape what the field chooses to optimize ( Raji et al., 2021 ). We focus on benchmarking, as opposed to AI evaluation more broadly, because the field has coordinated around benchmarks as a means of communicating model performance ( Hutchinson et al., 2022 ; Orr & Kang, 2024 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与上文所述的组织层面的困难相反，AI 基准测试在很大程度上是围绕基于任务的能力观念发展起来的。 AI 基准测试是用于为模型打分的测试。 一个基准测试规定一个问题，提供或提供获取解决问题所需信息的途径，并根据某种成功表现的标准来评估模型的回答。 基准测试主要有两大功能（此外还有其他功能）。 第一，它们是一种测量工具，使研究人员能够在同一组任务上比较不同系统（Donoho, 2017）。 第二，它们可以设定方向。 一旦某样东西可以被测量，实验室就可以对其进行爬坡优化并将其列为优先事项，这意味着基准测试能够塑造该领域选择优化的目标（Raji et al., 2021）。 我们聚焦于基准测试，而非更广义的 AI 评估，是因为该领域已经围绕基准测试协调一致，将其作为沟通模型表现的手段（Hutchinson et al., 2022; Orr & Kang, 2024）。

sents.en: In contrast to the organizational difficulty described above, AI benchmarking has largely developed around a task-based conception of capability.
sents.zh: 与上文所述的组织层面的困难相反，AI 基准测试在很大程度上是围绕基于任务的能力观念发展起来的。

sents.en: We focus on benchmarking, as opposed to AI evaluation more broadly, because the field has coordinated around benchmarks as a means of communicating model performance ( Hutchinson et al., 2022 ; Orr & Kang, 2024 ).
sents.zh: 我们聚焦于基准测试，而非更广义的 AI 评估，是因为该领域已经围绕基准测试协调一致，将其作为沟通模型表现的手段（Hutchinson et al., 2022; Orr & Kang, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks have changed as model capabilities have improved. The earliest benchmarks were often very narrow, built around single tasks such as image classification ( Deng et al., 2009 ) or a small set of language-understanding tasks ( Wang, Pruksachatkun, et al., 2019 ; Wang, Singh, et al., 2019 ). As these tasks became saturated ( Kiela et al., 2021 ), the field moved toward broader, harder, and more realistic tests of knowledge and reasoning ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Phan et al., 2025 ; Rein et al., 2024 ). More recently, benchmarks have shifted from grading simple prompt responses toward measuring models as agents operating within environments, such as resolving code issues or scanning over websites ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ). Similarly, benchmarks have moved toward tasks directly drawn from real professional work, in an attempt to measure how well models can contribute to productivity within a firm ( Kwa et al., 2025 ; Patwardhan et al., 2025 ).
paragraphs.zh: 随着模型能力的提升，基准测试也在不断演变。 最早的基准测试往往非常狭窄，围绕单一任务构建，例如图像分类（Deng 等，2009）或一小部分语言理解任务（Wang、Pruksachatkun 等，2019；Wang、Singh 等，2019）。 随着这些任务趋于饱和（Kiela 等，2021），该领域转向了更广泛、更困难、更贴近现实的有关知识与推理能力的测试（Hendrycks 等，2021；Phan 等，2025；Rein 等，2024）。 最近，基准测试已从对简单提示回复的评分，转向将模型作为在环境中运行的智能体来衡量，例如解决代码问题或浏览网站（Jimenez 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024）。 类似地，基准测试也开始直接采用源自真实职业工作的任务，以试图衡量模型在企业内部对生产力作出贡献的能力（Kwa 等，2025；Patwardhan 等，2025）。

sents.en: Benchmarks have changed as model capabilities have improved.
sents.zh: 随着模型能力的提升，基准测试也在不断演变。

sents.en: The earliest benchmarks were often very narrow, built around single tasks such as image classification ( Deng et al., 2009 ) or a small set of language-understanding tasks ( Wang, Pruksachatkun, et al., 2019 ; Wang, Singh, et al., 2019 ).

sents.en: More recently, benchmarks have shifted from grading simple prompt responses toward measuring models as agents operating within environments, such as resolving code issues or scanning over websites ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ).
sents.zh: 最近，基准测试已从对简单提示回复的评分，转向将模型作为在环境中运行的智能体来衡量，例如解决代码问题或浏览网站（Jimenez 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024）。

sents.en: Similarly, benchmarks have moved toward tasks directly drawn from real professional work, in an attempt to measure how well models can contribute to productivity within a firm ( Kwa et al., 2025 ; Patwardhan et al., 2025 ).
sents.zh: 类似地，基准测试也开始直接采用源自真实职业工作的任务，以试图衡量模型在企业内部对生产力作出贡献的能力（Kwa 等，2025；Patwardhan 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Across this evolution, however, the underlying logic of the benchmark has stayed largely the same. Difficulty is typically varied through properties of the focal task: the knowledge it requires, the complexity of the reasoning involved, the number of steps needed to complete it, the length of the relevant context, or the technical quality of the resulting output. Improvements in benchmark performance are then interpreted as evidence of improvements in the model’s capability to perform the corresponding class of tasks. This approach is well suited to measuring technical task difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在这一演变过程中，基准测试的底层逻辑基本上保持不变。 难度通常通过核心任务的属性来变化：它所需的知识、所涉及的推理复杂度、完成它所需的步骤数、相关上下文的长度，或最终输出的技术质量。 基准测试成绩的提升随后被解读为模型在执行相应类别任务方面能力提升的证据。 这种方法非常适合衡量技术性任务难度。

sents.en: Across this evolution, however, the underlying logic of the benchmark has stayed largely the same.
sents.zh: 然而，在这一演变过程中，基准测试的底层逻辑基本上保持不变。

sents.en: Difficulty is typically varied through properties of the focal task: the knowledge it requires, the complexity of the reasoning involved, the number of steps needed to complete it, the length of the relevant context, or the technical quality of the resulting output.
sents.zh: 难度通常通过核心任务的属性来变化：它所需的知识、所涉及的推理复杂度、完成它所需的步骤数、相关上下文的长度，或最终输出的技术质量。

sents.zh: 基准测试成绩的提升随后被解读为模型在执行相应类别任务方面能力提升的证据。

sents.en: This approach is well suited to measuring technical task difficulty.
sents.zh: 这种方法非常适合衡量技术性任务难度。

paragraphs.en: However, the same design choices tend to abstract from organizational difficulty. In many benchmark settings, the objective is given, relevant information is either provided or retrievable, the agent possesses the authority needed to act, and the surrounding environment remains comparatively stable while the task is performed. These assumptions are ordinarily invisible because they are built into the format rather than stated in it. A task arrives as a prompt, and whatever is not in the prompt is either retrievable or irrelevant. Other actors may appear, particularly in newer interactive or multi-agent benchmarks, but their presence does not necessarily create organizational dependence. Often, the agent’s own actions are the only source of change in the environment. Such a restriction is partly practical, since environments where other actors can alter the state of the world are harder to measure reliably and fairly. A common solution is to simulate these actors with LLMs, but whether LLM-simulated humans are valid stand-ins for real ones remains an open question ( Seshadri et al., 2026 ).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些相同的设计选择往往会把组织层面的困难抽象掉。 在许多基准测试场景中，目标是给定的，相关信息要么直接提供、要么可以检索得到，智能体拥有行动所需的权限，而且在任务执行过程中，周围环境相对保持稳定。 这些假设通常是不可见的，因为它们被内建于格式之中，而不是在格式中明确陈述。 任务以提示的形式到达，而不在提示中的内容要么可以检索得到，要么无关紧要。 其他行动者可能出现，特别是在较新的交互式或多智能体基准测试中，但他们的存在并不一定会造成组织上的依赖。 通常，智能体自身的行动是环境中唯一的变化来源。 这种限制有其现实层面的原因，因为在其他行动者能够改变世界状态的环境中，要可靠且公平地进行测量更加困难。 一种常见的解决方案是用大语言模型来模拟这些行动者，但大语言模型模拟的人类是否是真实人类的有效替代者，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题（ Seshadri et al., 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: This model is not wrong so much as it is silent about the setting (and holding organizational conditions constant can in some situations be essential for identifying technical capability). The design of many benchmarks therefore holds the organizational setting constant at a particular value—the null value—and in doing so removes from measurement precisely the conditions that the previous section identified as the source of organizational difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 这个模型并非错得多，而是对组织情境保持沉默（在某些情况下，将组织条件保持不变对识别技术能力来说可能至关重要）。 因此，许多基准测试的设计将组织情境固定在某个特定值——即空值——这样做恰恰把上一节指出的、构成组织困难来源的那些条件从测量中移除了。

paragraphs.en: The organizational setting surrounding a task can be described at several layers. Accordingly, we organize the organizational embedding of work into four analytically related layers across the structure of work, coordination requirements, governance mechanisms, and performance outcomes ( Table 1 ). The first layer, the structure of work , concerns the interdependence of activities, the structures of information, authority, temporality, and incentives, as well as environmental dynamism. At the second layer sit coordination requirements , which are generated by the structure of work. The third layer, governance mechanisms , can help address these requirements. Finally, at the fourth layer, how well these requirements are met shapes the performance outcomes at the organizational (or unit) level.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕任务的组织环境可以在多个层面上加以描述。 因此，我们将工作的组织嵌入划分为四个分析上相互关联的层面，涵盖工作结构、协调需求、治理机制和绩效结果（表1）。 第一个层面是工作结构，涉及活动的相互依赖性、信息、权威、时间性和激励的结构，以及环境的动态性。 第二个层面是协调需求，它由工作结构产生。 第三个层面是治理机制，可以帮助应对这些需求。 最后，在第四个层面，这些需求被满足的程度决定了组织（或单元）层面的绩效结果。

sents.zh: 第三个层面是治理机制，可以帮助应对这些需求。

sents.zh: 最后，在第四个层面，这些需求被满足的程度决定了组织（或单元）层面的绩效结果。

paragraphs.en: Consider a knowledge-intensive task within an organization where much of the relevant information is distributed across several actors ( Hayek, 1945 ). Here, distributed information is a feature of the structure of work. This distributed nature of information creates a coordination requirement for the information to be acquired and reconciled before the task can be completed. The organization can accordingly put in place governance mechanisms, including communication channels, information systems ( Galbraith, 1974 ), or escalation procedures, in order to help meet that requirement. Finally, whether the actor executing the task manages to obtain and integrate the information correctly can be described as contributing to the performance outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一个组织内的知识密集型任务，其中大量相关信息分布在多个参与者（Hayek, 1945）手中。 在这里，信息的分散是工作结构的一个特征。 信息的这种分散性质产生了协调需求，即在任务完成之前必须获取并整合这些信息。 因此，组织可以建立治理机制，包括沟通渠道、信息系统（Galbraith, 1974）或升级流程，以帮助满足该需求。 最后，执行任务的参与者能否正确获取并整合信息，可以被描述为对绩效结果的贡献。

sents.en: Consider a knowledge-intensive task within an organization where much of the relevant information is distributed across several actors ( Hayek, 1945 ).
sents.zh: 设想一个组织内的知识密集型任务，其中大量相关信息分布在多个参与者（Hayek, 1945）手中。

paragraphs.en: The taxonomy is intended as a guiding framework that can help the AI field draw on organization theory to evaluate how models navigate the organizational difficulty of tasks. It is not meant to be an exhaustive outline of organization theory but rather focuses on central ideas developed over the decades.
paragraphs.zh: 该分类法旨在作为一个指导性框架，帮助人工智能领域借鉴组织理论，以评估模型如何应对任务中的组织性难题。 它并非要对组织理论做穷尽式的概述，而是聚焦于数十年来发展出的一些核心思想。

sents.en: The taxonomy is intended as a guiding framework that can help the AI field draw on organization theory to evaluate how models navigate the organizational difficulty of tasks.
sents.zh: 该分类法旨在作为一个指导性框架，帮助人工智能领域借鉴组织理论，以评估模型如何应对任务中的组织性难题。

sents.en: It is not meant to be an exhaustive outline of organization theory but rather focuses on central ideas developed over the decades.
sents.zh: 它并非要对组织理论做穷尽式的概述，而是聚焦于数十年来发展出的一些核心思想。

paragraphs.en: The structure of work focuses on the organizational conditions that the actor is faced with when executing a task, before the organizational mechanisms are brought into play. Drawing on extant research in organization design and organizational economics, we identify six dimensions: task interdependence, information structure, authority structure, temporal structure, incentive structure, and environmental dynamism ( Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 工作结构关注的是行动者在执行任务时所面临的组织条件，此时组织机制尚未发挥作用。 基于组织设计与组织经济学的现有研究，我们识别出六个维度：任务相互依赖性、信息结构、权威结构、时间结构、激励结构以及环境动态性（表2）。

sents.en: The structure of work focuses on the organizational conditions that the actor is faced with when executing a task, before the organizational mechanisms are brought into play.
sents.zh: 工作结构关注的是行动者在执行任务时所面临的组织条件，此时组织机制尚未发挥作用。

sents.en: Drawing on extant research in organization design and organizational economics, we identify six dimensions: task interdependence, information structure, authority structure, temporal structure, incentive structure, and environmental dynamism ( Table 2 ).
sents.zh: 基于组织设计与组织经济学的现有研究，我们识别出六个维度：任务相互依赖性、信息结构、权威结构、时间结构、激励结构以及环境动态性（表2）。

paragraphs.en: Task interdependence concerns how performance of the focal task depends on other activities.
paragraphs.zh: 任务相互依赖性关注的是核心任务的执行如何依赖于其他活动。

paragraphs.en: Thompson’s (1967) formulation of interdependence distinguishes between three forms, namely pooled, sequential, and reciprocal. Pooled interdependence occurs when activities can be performed largely separately while still contributing to a common outcome. With sequential interdependence , the activities are sequentially interconnected such that the output of one becomes an input to another. Finally, reciprocal interdependence occurs when the outputs of each activity serve as inputs for the others, thereby requiring actors to adjust their activities to one another as work proceeds. As shown by empirical work, the different forms of interdependence are linked with different modes and intensities of coordination ( Van de Ven et al., 1976 ). Thompson (1967) treats the three forms of interdependence as cumulative, in the sense that sequential interdependence incorporates pooled interdependence, while reciprocal interdependence incorporates both. In line with this, in our classification we distinguish tasks according to the most demanding form of interdependence they exhibit, as these forms imply different coordination requirements.
paragraphs.zh: Thompson（1967）对相互依赖的界定区分了三种形式，即集合式、顺序式和互惠式。 集合式相互依赖是指各项活动可以在很大程度上独立开展，同时仍共同贡献于同一个结果。 在顺序式相互依赖中，各项活动按顺序相互衔接，前一活动的产出成为另一活动的投入。 最后，互惠式相互依赖是指每项活动的产出同时作为其他活动的投入，因而要求各行动者在工作推进过程中相互调整彼此的活动。 正如实证研究所表明的，不同形式的相互依赖对应着不同的协调方式与协调强度（Van de Ven et al., 1976）。 Thompson（1967）将这三种相互依赖形式视为累积性的，即顺序式相互依赖包含集合式相互依赖，而互惠式相互依赖则同时包含前两者。 与此相一致，我们在分类中根据任务所呈现的最严格的相互依赖形式来区分任务，因为这些形式意味着不同的协调要求。

sents.zh: Thompson（1967）对相互依赖的界定区分了三种形式，即集合式、顺序式和互惠式。

sents.zh: 正如实证研究所表明的，不同形式的相互依赖对应着不同的协调方式与协调强度（Van de Ven et al., 1976）。

sents.zh: Thompson（1967）将这三种相互依赖形式视为累积性的，即顺序式相互依赖包含集合式相互依赖，而互惠式相互依赖则同时包含前两者。

sents.zh: 与此相一致，我们在分类中根据任务所呈现的最严格的相互依赖形式来区分任务，因为这些形式意味着不同的协调要求。

paragraphs.en: Information structure concerns the distribution, accessibility, and character of knowledge needed to perform the focal task. Within organizations, the relevant knowledge may be concentrated with the focal actor or distributed across people, units, and information systems ( Hayek, 1945 ; March & Simon, 1958 ). Information within the organization may also be inconsistent or contradictory , in the sense that different sources may present conflicting facts or opinions that the actor must resolve. Furthermore, some of the knowledge held by the actors within organizations is characterized by its tacitness , where it cannot necessarily be put into words, but must instead be inferred from examples or practice ( Polanyi, 1966 ).
paragraphs.zh: 信息结构涉及完成焦点任务所需知识的分布、可及性与特征。 在组织内部，相关知识可能集中于焦点行动者，也可能分布于人员、单元和信息系统之中（Hayek, 1945; March & Simon, 1958）。 组织内的信息也可能不一致或相互矛盾，即不同来源可能呈现相互冲突的事实或观点，而行动者必须对此加以解决。 此外，组织内行动者所掌握的部分知识具有隐性特征，即此类知识未必能用言语表达，而只能通过实例或实践加以推断（Polanyi, 1966）。

sents.en: Information structure concerns the distribution, accessibility, and character of knowledge needed to perform the focal task.
sents.zh: 信息结构涉及完成焦点任务所需知识的分布、可及性与特征。

sents.en: Within organizations, the relevant knowledge may be concentrated with the focal actor or distributed across people, units, and information systems ( Hayek, 1945 ; March & Simon, 1958 ).
sents.zh: 在组织内部，相关知识可能集中于焦点行动者，也可能分布于人员、单元和信息系统之中（Hayek, 1945; March & Simon, 1958）。

sents.en: Information within the organization may also be inconsistent or contradictory , in the sense that different sources may present conflicting facts or opinions that the actor must resolve.
sents.zh: 组织内的信息也可能不一致或相互矛盾，即不同来源可能呈现相互冲突的事实或观点，而行动者必须对此加以解决。

sents.en: Furthermore, some of the knowledge held by the actors within organizations is characterized by its tacitness , where it cannot necessarily be put into words, but must instead be inferred from examples or practice ( Polanyi, 1966 ).
sents.zh: 此外，组织内行动者所掌握的部分知识具有隐性特征，即此类知识未必能用言语表达，而只能通过实例或实践加以推断（Polanyi, 1966）。

paragraphs.en: Importantly, organizational information dependence arises when obtaining, interpreting, or validating task-relevant knowledge depends on other actors or on systems whose access, maintenance, or use is governed organizationally. This distinction separates organizational information dependencies from simple retrieval of information, as the information is not directly accessible to the actor, but hinges on other actors or systems controlled by the organization. Information-processing approaches to organization design have long treated the demands imposed by such information structures as central determinants of organizational arrangements ( Galbraith, 1974 ; Tushman & Nadler, 1978 ).
paragraphs.zh: 重要的是，当获取、解释或验证与任务相关的知识依赖于其他行动者，或依赖于其访问、维护或使用受组织管控的系统时，就会产生组织性信息依赖。 这一区分将组织性信息依赖与简单的信息检索区分开来，因为行动者无法直接获取该信息，而是取决于其他行动者或由组织控制的系统。 组织设计的信息处理方法长期以来一直将这类信息结构所施加的要求视为组织安排的核心决定因素（Galbraith, 1974; Tushman & Nadler, 1978）。

sents.en: Importantly, organizational information dependence arises when obtaining, interpreting, or validating task-relevant knowledge depends on other actors or on systems whose access, maintenance, or use is governed organizationally.
sents.zh: 重要的是，当获取、解释或验证与任务相关的知识依赖于其他行动者，或依赖于其访问、维护或使用受组织管控的系统时，就会产生组织性信息依赖。

sents.en: This distinction separates organizational information dependencies from simple retrieval of information, as the information is not directly accessible to the actor, but hinges on other actors or systems controlled by the organization.
sents.zh: 这一区分将组织性信息依赖与简单的信息检索区分开来，因为行动者无法直接获取该信息，而是取决于其他行动者或由组织控制的系统。

sents.en: Information-processing approaches to organization design have long treated the demands imposed by such information structures as central determinants of organizational arrangements ( Galbraith, 1974 ; Tushman & Nadler, 1978 ).
sents.zh: 组织设计的信息处理方法长期以来一直将这类信息结构所施加的要求视为组织安排的核心决定因素（Galbraith, 1974; Tushman & Nadler, 1978）。

paragraphs.en: Authority structure concerns who can request, decide, approve, override, and oblige.
paragraphs.zh: 权限结构涉及谁可以请求、决定、批准、覆盖和强制执行。

paragraphs.en: Within organizations, it is not a given that knowledge and authority reside with the same actor. Rather, an employee may possess the expertise required to identify and formulate an appropriate course of action, but not necessarily possess the right to implement it. Conversely, a manager may hold the formal authority over a decision, but not necessarily possess the most relevant knowledge. Formal authority thus refers to the right to decide, typically derived from position or contract, while real authority refers to the effective control over decisions that rests in part on holding relevant knowledge ( Aghion & Tirole, 1997 ). Within the field of organization theory, authority has long been treated as a means of coordinating specialized activities ( Simon, 1947 ), while organizational economics has also examined how decision rights can be allocated in response to the location and transfer costs of knowledge ( Jensen & Meckling, 1992 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在组织内部，知识和权威并不一定由同一个行为者掌握。 恰恰相反，员工可能具备识别并制定适当行动方案所需的专业知识，却不一定拥有实施该方案的权利。 反之，管理者可能对某项决策拥有正式权威，却不一定掌握最相关的知识。 因此，正式权威指的是决策的权利，通常来源于职位或合同，而实际权威指的是对决策的有效控制，这种控制部分取决于掌握相关知识（Aghion & Tirole, 1997）。 在组织理论领域，权威长期以来被视为协调专业化活动的一种手段（Simon, 1947），而组织经济学也考察了决策权如何根据知识所在位置及其转移成本进行分配（Jensen & Meckling, 1992）。

sents.zh: 在组织内部，知识和权威并不一定由同一个行为者掌握。

sents.en: Rather, an employee may possess the expertise required to identify and formulate an appropriate course of action, but not necessarily possess the right to implement it.

sents.zh: 反之，管理者可能对某项决策拥有正式权威，却不一定掌握最相关的知识。

sents.en: Formal authority thus refers to the right to decide, typically derived from position or contract, while real authority refers to the effective control over decisions that rests in part on holding relevant knowledge ( Aghion & Tirole, 1997 ).
sents.zh: 因此，正式权威指的是决策的权利，通常来源于职位或合同，而实际权威指的是对决策的有效控制，这种控制部分取决于掌握相关知识（Aghion & Tirole, 1997）。

paragraphs.en: Temporal structure captures dependencies created by sequencing, deadlines, response latency, interruptions, and simultaneous streams of activity. Sequential interdependence of activities, as outlined earlier, already introduces a temporal ordering of tasks ( Thompson, 1967 ), but work within organizations can also impose further temporal constraints. This is the case, for instance, when actors must wait for information or authorization from their managers, coordinate deadlines with other departments, or act within a time window to meet a deadline. Thus, task interdependence can introduce a sequential order of activities, while the temporal structure refers to when, at a given point in time, the task’s actions must occur. Temporal structure is then not simply about how much time a task takes, but whether its successful completion depends on when other activities occur.
paragraphs.zh: 时间结构捕捉的是由先后顺序、期限、响应延迟、中断以及同时进行的多重活动流所形成的依赖关系。 如前文所述，活动之间的顺序相互依赖（Thompson, 1967）已经引入了任务的时间排序，但组织内部的工作还可能施加进一步的时间限制。 例如，当行动者必须等待来自其管理者（智能体）的信息或授权、与其他部门协调期限，或必须在某个时间窗口内采取行动以赶上截止日期时，情况就是如此。 因此，任务相互依赖可以引入活动的先后顺序，而时间结构指的是任务的行动在某个给定时间点上必须于何时发生。 因此，时间结构并不仅仅是关于一项任务需要多少时间，而是关于其成功完成是否取决于其他活动于何时发生。

sents.zh: 时间结构捕捉的是由先后顺序、期限、响应延迟、中断以及同时进行的多重活动流所形成的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Incentive structure concerns the alignment or divergence of actors’ objectives and the consequences attached to their actions, including rewards, penalties, performance measures, and other mechanisms that shape behavior. Alignment here refers to objectives which may be closely aligned, partly divergent, or directly conflicting, reflecting the coalitional view of organizations, in which participants bargain over the goals of the firm ( March, 1962 ). Multiple goals often coexist within organizations and are not necessarily fixed objectives ( Cyert & March, 1963 ; Gaba & Greve, 2019 ). Rather, these goals evolve as the relevant context changes both inside and outside the organization. Consequence-bearing mechanisms , on the other hand, relate to the rewards, penalties, performance measures, and other behavior-inducing mechanisms that shape how actors pursue these objectives. Coordination between actors with aligned objectives differs significantly from coordination where cooperation must be induced, where actors withhold information or delay action, or where they pursue competing outcomes ( Jensen & Meckling, 1976 ; Williamson, 1985 ).
paragraphs.zh: 激励结构涉及行动者目标之间的一致或分歧，以及与其行动相关联的后果，包括奖励、惩罚、绩效衡量以及其他塑造行为的机制。 这里的一致性是指目标之间可能高度一致、部分分歧或直接冲突，这体现了组织的联盟视角，即参与者就企业的目标进行讨价还价（March, 1962）。 组织内部往往同时存在多重目标，而这些目标并不一定是固定不变的（Cyert & March, 1963；Gaba & Greve, 2019）。 相反，这些目标会随着组织内外相关情境的变化而不断演变。 另一方面，承载后果的机制涉及奖励、惩罚、绩效衡量以及其他引导行为的机制，它们塑造了行动者追求这些目标的方式。 目标一致的行动者之间的协调，与必须诱导合作的协调、行动者隐瞒信息或拖延行动的协调，或行动者追求相互竞争的结果的协调，存在显著差异（Jensen & Meckling, 1976；Williamson, 1985）。

paragraphs.en: In AI-mediated organizational work, such structures may involve human actors as well as AI agents whose behavior is shaped by assigned objectives, evaluation criteria, or system-level constraints. The concept therefore does not presuppose human psychological motivation, but captures how differences in objectives and consequences condition organizational cooperation.
paragraphs.zh: 在以人工智能为中介的组织工作中，此类结构可能既涉及人类行动者，也涉及智能体（agents），后者的行为受分配的目标、评估标准或系统层面约束的塑造。 因此，这一概念并不预设人类的心理动机，而是刻画目标与后果的差异如何制约组织内的合作。

sents.en: In AI-mediated organizational work, such structures may involve human actors as well as AI agents whose behavior is shaped by assigned objectives, evaluation criteria, or system-level constraints.
sents.zh: 在以人工智能为中介的组织工作中，此类结构可能既涉及人类行动者，也涉及智能体（agents），后者的行为受分配的目标、评估标准或系统层面约束的塑造。

sents.zh: 因此，这一概念并不预设人类的心理动机，而是刻画目标与后果的差异如何制约组织内的合作。

paragraphs.en: Environmental dynamism concerns the stability of the conditions relevant to task performance. Environmental conditions often change while a task is underway, such as with technologies, customer demands, or decisions elsewhere in the organization. For example, a task can become significantly more organizationally demanding if the conditions on which the original plan was based suddenly change during task execution. Contingency and information-processing theories have long established the link between uncertainty and change in the environment and greater demands for information processing and adaptation ( Burton & Obel, 2004 ; Lawrence & Lorsch, 1967 ). Environmental dynamism can also interact with the other dimensions in the taxonomy. For instance, in a highly dynamic environment, such as with a fast-growing startup, the effective control to make decisions can shift quickly, implying that this dynamism also has implications for authority structures. Furthermore, experienced actors in dynamic environments may be able to anticipate certain changes in task conditions, but in many instances dynamism entails change that is hard to predict ( Dess & Beard, 1984 ) or even impossible to predict.
paragraphs.zh: 环境动态性涉及与任务执行相关的条件的稳定性。 环境条件常常在任务进行过程中发生变化，例如技术、客户需求或组织其他地方的决策发生变化。 例如，如果原有计划所依据的条件在任务执行期间突然发生变化，任务可能会在组织层面变得明显更具挑战性。 权变理论与信息处理理论早已确立了环境中的不确定性和变化与更高的信息处理和适应需求之间的联系（Burton & Obel, 2004；Lawrence & Lorsch, 1967）。 环境动态性还可以与分类体系中的其他维度发生交互作用。 例如，在高度动态的环境中，例如在快速成长的初创企业中，做出决策的有效控制权可能会迅速转移，这意味着这种动态性对权威结构也有影响。 此外，动态环境中的经验丰富的行动者或许能够预判任务条件的某些变化，但在许多情况下，动态性所蕴含的变化是难以预测的（Dess & Beard, 1984），甚至是完全无法预测的。

sents.en: Environmental dynamism concerns the stability of the conditions relevant to task performance.
sents.zh: 环境动态性涉及与任务执行相关的条件的稳定性。

sents.zh: 环境条件常常在任务进行过程中发生变化，例如技术、客户需求或组织其他地方的决策发生变化。
