sents.zh: 第 1 层的定义和注释均按原文逐字复制。

sents.en: Layers 2–4 item names and descriptions are verbatim from the four-layer taxonomy.
sents.zh: 第 2–4 层的条目名称和描述均逐字取自该四层分类体系。

paragraphs.en: Initial pass (Layer 1). We feed the full paper text into the model’s context, together with the definitions of the six dimensions, their subcomponents and the tagging notes in section E2 . For each dimension, the model returns a yes/no answer to the following questions:
paragraphs.zh: 初步 pass（第 1 层）。 我们将论文全文输入模型的上下文，同时附上六个维度的定义、其子组件以及 E2 节中的标注说明。 对于每个维度，模型会对以下问题返回是/否的答案：

sents.en: Initial pass (Layer 1).
sents.zh: 初步 pass（第 1 层）。

sents.en: We feed the full paper text into the model’s context, together with the definitions of the six dimensions, their subcomponents and the tagging notes in section E2 .
sents.zh: 我们将论文全文输入模型的上下文，同时附上六个维度的定义、其子组件以及 E2 节中的标注说明。

sents.en: For each dimension, the model returns a yes/no answer to the following questions:
sents.zh: 对于每个维度，模型会对以下问题返回是/否的答案：

paragraphs.en: Mention: “Does this passage discuss the dimension in any way?” A yes means the paper “talks about the dimension as defined, anywhere in the paper: motivation, related work, the benchmark itself, results, limitations or future work all count.”
paragraphs.zh: 提及：“该段落是否以任何方式讨论了该维度？”若回答是，则表示该论文“在论文中任何地方都谈到了该定义的维度：动机、相关工作、基准测试本身、结果、局限性或未来工作都算在内。”

paragraphs.en: Claim: “Does this passage state that the paper’s own benchmark tests the dimension?” A yes means the paper “says the benchmark presented in this paper contains the dimension in its tasks, its environment, or its grader (for example, the agent must deal with it to complete tasks, the environment simulates it, or grading checks it).” “Discussion of other benchmarks or prior work, general motivation, limitations, or future work does not count.”
paragraphs.zh: 主张：“这段文字是否说明该论文自身的基准测试了该维度？”回答“是”意味着论文“说明本文提出的基准在其任务、环境或评分器中包含该维度（例如，智能体必须处理它才能完成任务、环境对其进行了模拟，或评分时检查了它）。”“对其他基准或先前工作的讨论、一般性动机、局限性或未来工作不算在内。”

paragraphs.en: Measure: “Does this passage report a result that measures the dimension separately?” A yes means the paper “reports a result of this paper’s benchmark that isolates the dimension: a dedicated metric or score for it, an ablation that varies it, or a failure analysis that attributes errors to it.” “Results that only fold it into overall task success, or results about other things, do not count.”
paragraphs.zh: Measure：“该段落是否报告了单独衡量该维度的结果？”若为是，则表示该论文“报告了本文基准测试中隔离该维度的结果：即针对该维度的专用指标或分数、改变该维度的消融实验，或将错误归因于该维度的失败分析。”“仅将其并入整体任务成功的结果，或关于其他方面的结果，均不计入。”

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents and the established-dimension rule. For each claimed dimension, the model first records where it appears (task, environment or grader), the subcomponent values present, and, for task interdependence, authority structure and incentive structure, the other actor involved; only then does it decide whether the dimension is established. A claim counts only if a feature subcomponent is present, a scale subcomponent takes a non-baseline value, or the dimension fits the overall definition without any subcomponent (with a stated reason); task interdependence additionally requires another distinct actor. We also check this rule in code. For a measure, the model records whether the isolating result is quantitative (a metric, score or ablation) or qualitative (a failure analysis). Subcomponent values are recorded in the format listed in section E2 .
paragraphs.zh: 子成分与既定维度规则。 对于每个所主张的维度，模型首先记录其出现的位置（任务、环境或评分器）、存在的子成分值，以及对于任务相互依赖性而言的权威结构与激励结构所涉及的另一个行动者；然后才判断该维度是否成立。 只有当存在特征子成分、某个尺度子成分取非基线值，或该维度在没有任何子成分的情况下符合总体定义（需说明理由）时，该主张才算成立；任务相互依赖性还要求存在另一个不同的行动者。 我们还在代码中检查了这一规则。 对于每项测量，模型会记录其隔离结果是定量的（指标、分数或消融实验）还是定性的（失败分析）。 子成分值按照 E2 节列出的格式进行记录。

sents.en: Subcomponents and the established-dimension rule.
sents.zh: 子成分与既定维度规则。

sents.en: For each claimed dimension, the model first records where it appears (task, environment or grader), the subcomponent values present, and, for task interdependence, authority structure and incentive structure, the other actor involved; only then does it decide whether the dimension is established.
sents.zh: 对于每个所主张的维度，模型首先记录其出现的位置（任务、环境或评分器）、存在的子成分值，以及对于任务相互依赖性而言的权威结构与激励结构所涉及的另一个行动者；然后才判断该维度是否成立。

sents.en: A claim counts only if a feature subcomponent is present, a scale subcomponent takes a non-baseline value, or the dimension fits the overall definition without any subcomponent (with a stated reason); task interdependence additionally requires another distinct actor.
sents.zh: 只有当存在特征子成分、某个尺度子成分取非基线值，或该维度在没有任何子成分的情况下符合总体定义（需说明理由）时，该主张才算成立；任务相互依赖性还要求存在另一个不同的行动者。

sents.en: We also check this rule in code.
sents.zh: 我们还在代码中检查了这一规则。

sents.en: For a measure, the model records whether the isolating result is quantitative (a metric, score or ablation) or qualitative (a failure analysis).
sents.zh: 对于每项测量，模型会记录其隔离结果是定量的（指标、分数或消融实验）还是定性的（失败分析）。

sents.en: Subcomponent values are recorded in the format listed in section E2 .
sents.zh: 子成分值按照 E2 节列出的格式进行记录。

paragraphs.en: Quotations. Every yes requires the model to give a verbatim quote of forty words or fewer from the paper to justify its label.
paragraphs.zh: 引用。 每一个“是”都要求模型从论文中逐字引用不超过四十个词的内容，以支持其标注。

sents.en: Quotations.
sents.zh: 引用。

sents.en: Every yes requires the model to give a verbatim quote of forty words or fewer from the paper to justify its label.
sents.zh: 每一个“是”都要求模型从论文中逐字引用不超过四十个词的内容，以支持其标注。

paragraphs.en: Follow-up pass (Layers 2–4). For each dimension the paper claims or measures, we make one model call per dimension, again with the full paper text and the items in section E3 . These calls code the following:
paragraphs.zh: 后续处理（第 2–4 层）。 对于论文声称或测量的每个维度，我们对每个维度进行一次模型调用，同样使用完整的论文文本以及 E3 节中的条目。 这些调用对以下内容进行编码：

sents.en: Follow-up pass (Layers 2–4).
sents.zh: 后续处理（第 2–4 层）。

sents.en: For each dimension the paper claims or measures, we make one model call per dimension, again with the full paper text and the items in section E3 .
sents.zh: 对于论文声称或测量的每个维度，我们对每个维度进行一次模型调用，同样使用完整的论文文本以及 E3 节中的条目。

sents.en: These calls code the following:
sents.zh: 这些调用对以下内容进行编码：

paragraphs.en: Layer 2 (coordination requirements): “Does the paper claim the benchmark’s tasks REQUIRE the agent to do this? Count it only if the task cannot be completed without it.”
paragraphs.zh: 层次2（协调性要求）：「论文是否声称该基准测试的任务要求智能体做到这一点？ 只有当任务缺少它就无法完成时才计入。」

sents.en: Layer 2 (coordination requirements): “Does the paper claim the benchmark’s tasks REQUIRE the agent to do this?
sents.zh: 层次2（协调性要求）：「论文是否声称该基准测试的任务要求智能体做到这一点？

sents.en: Count it only if the task cannot be completed without it.”
sents.zh: 只有当任务缺少它就无法完成时才计入。」

paragraphs.en: Layer 3 (governance mechanisms): “Does the paper claim the benchmark’s environment SUPPLIES this mechanism?”
paragraphs.zh: 第3层（治理机制）：「论文是否声称该基准测试的环境提供（SUPPLIES）此机制？」

paragraphs.en: Layer 4 (performance outcomes): “Does the paper claim the benchmark’s grader CHECKS this outcome?”
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 层（性能结果）：「论文是否声称基准的评分器会检验这一结果？」

paragraphs.en: Each is answered “yes”, “absent” (the paper makes clear the benchmark does not have it) or “not established” (the paper does not say either way), and every yes again requires a verbatim quote.
paragraphs.zh: 每一项均回答为“是”、“缺失”（论文明确说明基准中不存在该项）或“未确立”（论文未明确说明），且每个“是”同样需要逐字引用作为依据。

paragraphs.en: Final check. We search the paper text for each quote, allowing for page breaks that interrupt it, and eliminate labels whose quote cannot be found.
paragraphs.zh: 最终检查。 我们在论文文本中搜索每条引文，允许分页将其打断，并剔除无法找到其引文的标签。

sents.en: Final check.
sents.zh: 最终检查。

sents.en: We search the paper text for each quote, allowing for page breaks that interrupt it, and eliminate labels whose quote cannot be found.
sents.zh: 我们在论文文本中搜索每条引文，允许分页将其打断，并剔除无法找到其引文的标签。

paragraphs.en: Consistency check. We re-ran the Layer 1 tagging for 40 benchmarks with identical settings; the two runs agreed on 94 percent of claim tags.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性检查。 我们在相同设置下对 40 个基准重新运行了 Layer 1 标注；两次运行在 94% 的论断标签上一致。

sents.en: Consistency check.
sents.zh: 一致性检查。

sents.en: We re-ran the Layer 1 tagging for 40 benchmarks with identical settings; the two runs agreed on 94 percent of claim tags.
sents.zh: 我们在相同设置下对 40 个基准重新运行了 Layer 1 标注；两次运行在 94% 的论断标签上一致。

paragraphs.en: Development of the definitions. The tagging definitions and notes were developed iteratively: we ran the tagging, reviewed the outputs against the concepts, and refined the definitions where the tags did not capture what we intended.
paragraphs.zh: 定义的制定。 这些标注定义及注释是经过多轮迭代制定的：我们先进行标注，再将标注结果与相关概念进行对照审查，并在标注未能体现我们意图的地方对定义加以完善。

sents.en: Development of the definitions.
sents.zh: 定义的制定。

sents.en: The tagging definitions and notes were developed iteratively: we ran the tagging, reviewed the outputs against the concepts, and refined the definitions where the tags did not capture what we intended.
sents.zh: 这些标注定义及注释是经过多轮迭代制定的：我们先进行标注，再将标注结果与相关概念进行对照审查，并在标注未能体现我们意图的地方对定义加以完善。

paragraphs.en: Definition: The interdependency between the focal task and other activities, e.g. the output of one activity is the input to another.
paragraphs.zh: 定义：焦点任务与其他活动之间的相互依赖关系，例如一个活动的输出是另一个活动的输入。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents: Pooled: Each activity makes a discrete contribution to the whole and is supported by it, without direct exchange between activities. Sequential: One activity’s output becomes another activity’s input, so the first must be completed before the second can proceed. Reciprocal: Each activity’s output becomes an input for the other, so each poses a contingency for the other and must adjust as work proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 子组件：汇集式：每项活动对整体做出独立的贡献并得到整体的支持，活动之间没有直接交换。 顺序式：一项活动的输出成为另一项活动的输入，因此前一项必须完成后，后一项才能进行。 互惠式：每项活动的输出都成为对方的输入，因此每一方都对另一方构成偶发因素，并须随工作的推进不断调整。

sents.en: Subcomponents: Pooled: Each activity makes a discrete contribution to the whole and is supported by it, without direct exchange between activities.
sents.zh: 子组件：汇集式：每项活动对整体做出独立的贡献并得到整体的支持，活动之间没有直接交换。

sents.en: Sequential: One activity’s output becomes another activity’s input, so the first must be completed before the second can proceed.
sents.zh: 顺序式：一项活动的输出成为另一项活动的输入，因此前一项必须完成后，后一项才能进行。

sents.en: Reciprocal: Each activity’s output becomes an input for the other, so each poses a contingency for the other and must adjust as work proceeds.
sents.zh: 互惠式：每项活动的输出都成为对方的输入，因此每一方都对另一方构成偶发因素，并须随工作的推进不断调整。

paragraphs.en: The three forms are cumulative; tag the most demanding form present, not three separate yes/no variables.
paragraphs.zh: 这三种形式是累加的；请标注所出现的最高要求的形式，而不是设置三个单独的是/否变量。

paragraphs.en: Interdependence is between activities of different actors or departmental units within an organization; steps within one agent’s own task do not count.
paragraphs.zh: 相互依赖存在于组织内不同行动者或部门单位的活动之间；某个智能体自身任务内部的步骤不计入其中。

paragraphs.en: Task interdependence structure covers the order which arises because one activity’s output is another’s input. Where an order arises that states when a task’s actions must occur (waiting for others, deadlines and windows, and interruptions), tag temporal structure instead.
paragraphs.zh: 任务相互依赖结构涵盖了由于一项活动的输出是另一项活动的输入而产生的顺序。 当出现的顺序规定了任务的行动必须何时发生（等待他人、截止期限与时间窗口，以及中断）时，应改而标注为时间结构。

sents.en: Task interdependence structure covers the order which arises because one activity’s output is another’s input.
sents.zh: 任务相互依赖结构涵盖了由于一项活动的输出是另一项活动的输入而产生的顺序。

sents.en: Where an order arises that states when a task’s actions must occur (waiting for others, deadlines and windows, and interruptions), tag temporal structure instead.
sents.zh: 当出现的顺序规定了任务的行动必须何时发生（等待他人、截止期限与时间窗口，以及中断）时，应改而标注为时间结构。

paragraphs.en: Interdependence must be with other distinct actors in the environment. Sub-agents, child agents, and other agents that the focal agent creates or calls as tools are part of its own task and do not count.
paragraphs.zh: 相互依赖必须存在于环境中其他不同的参与者之间。 子智能体、子代智能体，以及焦点智能体创建或作为工具调用的其他智能体，都属于其自身任务的一部分，不算作其他参与者。

sents.en: Interdependence must be with other distinct actors in the environment.
sents.zh: 相互依赖必须存在于环境中其他不同的参与者之间。

sents.en: Sub-agents, child agents, and other agents that the focal agent creates or calls as tools are part of its own task and do not count.
sents.zh: 子智能体、子代智能体，以及焦点智能体创建或作为工具调用的其他智能体，都属于其自身任务的一部分，不算作其他参与者。

paragraphs.en: Recorded as: form=pooled|sequential|reciprocal|not_established (the most demanding form present)
paragraphs.zh: 记录为：form=pooled|sequential|reciprocal|not_established（当前存在的最严格要求的形式）

paragraphs.en: Definition: The distribution, accessibility, and character of task-relevant knowledge across organizational actors and information systems, including whether acquiring or validating that knowledge depends on other actors’ actions or authority.
paragraphs.zh: 定义：任务相关知识在组织中的各行为者和信息系统之间的分布、可及性与特征，包括获取或验证这些知识是否依赖于其他行为者的行动或权威。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents: Location (scale): concentrated vs. distributed (held by other actors, and information systems, where acquisition and validation of that knowledge depends on other actors’ actions or authority). Consistency (scale): consistent vs. contradictory. Codifiability (scale): tacit vs. explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 子组件：位置（规模）：集中式与分布式（由其他参与者持有，以及由信息系统持有，其中该知识的获取与验证取决于其他参与者的行动或权限）。 一致性（规模）：一致与矛盾。 可编码性（规模）：隐性知识与显性知识。

sents.en: Subcomponents: Location (scale): concentrated vs. distributed (held by other actors, and information systems, where acquisition and validation of that knowledge depends on other actors’ actions or authority).
sents.zh: 子组件：位置（规模）：集中式与分布式（由其他参与者持有，以及由信息系统持有，其中该知识的获取与验证取决于其他参与者的行动或权限）。

sents.en: Consistency (scale): consistent vs. contradictory.
sents.zh: 一致性（规模）：一致与矛盾。

sents.en: Codifiability (scale): tacit vs. explicit.
sents.zh: 可编码性（规模）：隐性知识与显性知识。

paragraphs.en: Documents that are supplied and can be accessed by the agent alone count as concentrated, even if there are a lot.
paragraphs.zh: 仅由智能体提供且可被智能体单独访问的文档算作集中式的，即使数量很多。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge that must be requested from a person is distributed (location). It is tacit only when it cannot readily be put into words, even by the person who holds it, and must instead be inferred from examples or practice.
paragraphs.zh: 必须向人请求才能获得的知识是分布式的（位置维度）。 只有当它难以被言明时——即使是掌握它的人也难以用语言表达，而必须通过示例或实践来推断——它才是隐性知识。

sents.en: Knowledge that must be requested from a person is distributed (location).
sents.zh: 必须向人请求才能获得的知识是分布式的（位置维度）。

sents.en: It is tacit only when it cannot readily be put into words, even by the person who holds it, and must instead be inferred from examples or practice.
sents.zh: 只有当它难以被言明时——即使是掌握它的人也难以用语言表达，而必须通过示例或实践来推断——它才是隐性知识。

paragraphs.en: Concentrated, consistent and explicit are baseline values: record them, but they do not establish the dimension alone.
paragraphs.zh: 集中、一致和明确是基准值：记录它们，但它们本身不足以确立该维度。

paragraphs.en: Record all of the subcomponents (location, consistency, codifiability), with one of the two respective values chosen for each, e.g. choosing tacit for the codifiability subcomponent.
paragraphs.zh: 记录所有子组件（位置、一致性、可编码性），每个子组件从两个相应值中选择一个，例如为可编码性子组件选择「隐性」。

paragraphs.en: Recorded as: location=concentrated|distributed|not_established; consistency=consistent|contradictory|not_established; codifiability=tacit|explicit|not_established
paragraphs.zh: 记录为：location=concentrated|distributed|not_established; consistency=consistent|contradictory|not_established; codifiability=tacit|explicit|not_established

paragraphs.en: Definition: The authority to request, decide, approve, override and oblige.
paragraphs.zh: 定义：请求、决定、批准、推翻和强制的权限。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents: Formal authority (feature): the right to decide, derived from position or contract. Real authority (feature): effective control, in part from holding relevant knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 子组成部分：正式权威（特征）：源自职位或合同的决定权。 实际权威（特征）：有效控制，部分来自掌握相关知识。

sents.en: Subcomponents: Formal authority (feature): the right to decide, derived from position or contract.
sents.zh: 子组成部分：正式权威（特征）：源自职位或合同的决定权。

sents.en: Real authority (feature): effective control, in part from holding relevant knowledge.
sents.zh: 实际权威（特征）：有效控制，部分来自掌握相关知识。

paragraphs.en: Record formal or real authority separately, each as present or absent within the task.
paragraphs.zh: 分别记录正式权威或实际权威，每项均记录其在任务中是否存在。

paragraphs.en: Real authority applies when the effective control lies with an actor that is different from the formal holder. Formal authority can be present without real authority, while the presence of real authority also implies that formal authority is present. Both can therefore be present in the same task.
paragraphs.zh: 当有效控制权归属于不同于形式持有者的行为主体时，即存在实际权威。 形式权威可以在没有实际权威的情况下存在，而实际权威的存在也意味着形式权威存在。 因此，两者可以同时存在于同一任务中。

sents.en: Real authority applies when the effective control lies with an actor that is different from the formal holder.
sents.zh: 当有效控制权归属于不同于形式持有者的行为主体时，即存在实际权威。

sents.en: Formal authority can be present without real authority, while the presence of real authority also implies that formal authority is present.
sents.zh: 形式权威可以在没有实际权威的情况下存在，而实际权威的存在也意味着形式权威存在。

sents.en: Both can therefore be present in the same task.
sents.zh: 因此，两者可以同时存在于同一任务中。

paragraphs.en: A written policy counts as formal authority when it instructs the role (what the actor may decide or grant on the organization’s behalf), not when it only specifies the task.
paragraphs.zh: 一份书面政策只有在它规定了该角色（行为者可以代表组织决定或授予什么）时，才算作正式权威；如果它只是说明了任务，则不算。

paragraphs.en: Recorded as: formal=present|absent; real=present|absent
paragraphs.zh: 记录为：formal=present|absent；real=present|absent

paragraphs.en: Definition: The timing and order in which things must take place.
paragraphs.zh: 定义：事物必须发生的时间和顺序。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents: Latency (feature): waiting time for input or other actor’s response. Sequencing (feature): order of tasks across time. Time constraint (feature): deadlines, windows, interruptions.
paragraphs.zh: 子组件：时延（特征）：等待输入或其他智能体响应的时间。 排序（特征）：任务在时间上的先后顺序。 时间约束（特征）：截止期限、时间窗口、中断。

sents.en: Subcomponents: Latency (feature): waiting time for input or other actor’s response.
sents.zh: 子组件：时延（特征）：等待输入或其他智能体响应的时间。

sents.en: Sequencing (feature): order of tasks across time.
sents.zh: 排序（特征）：任务在时间上的先后顺序。

sents.en: Time constraint (feature): deadlines, windows, interruptions.
sents.zh: 时间约束（特征）：截止期限、时间窗口、中断。

paragraphs.en: Temporal structure covers when the task’s actions must occur: waiting for others, deadlines and windows, and interruptions. Where an order arises only because one activity’s output is another’s input, tag task interdependence instead.
paragraphs.zh: 时间结构涵盖任务动作必须发生的时间点：等待他人、截止日期与时间窗口，以及中断。 若顺序仅因一项活动的输出是另一项活动的输入而产生，请改标注任务相互依赖性。

sents.en: Temporal structure covers when the task’s actions must occur: waiting for others, deadlines and windows, and interruptions.
sents.zh: 时间结构涵盖任务动作必须发生的时间点：等待他人、截止日期与时间窗口，以及中断。

sents.en: Where an order arises only because one activity’s output is another’s input, tag task interdependence instead.
sents.zh: 若顺序仅因一项活动的输出是另一项活动的输入而产生，请改标注任务相互依赖性。

paragraphs.en: Time limits count when they are part of the task as presented to the agent (e.g., a deadline set by a client or manager). Limits on running the evaluation (wall-clock, compute, step budgets) do not.
paragraphs.zh: 当时限作为呈现给智能体的任务的一部分时（例如客户或经理设定的截止日期），则计入在内。 运行评估时的限制（实际耗时、算力、步骤预算）则不计入。

sents.en: Time limits count when they are part of the task as presented to the agent (e.g., a deadline set by a client or manager).
sents.zh: 当时限作为呈现给智能体的任务的一部分时（例如客户或经理设定的截止日期），则计入在内。

sents.en: Limits on running the evaluation (wall-clock, compute, step budgets) do not.
sents.zh: 运行评估时的限制（实际耗时、算力、步骤预算）则不计入。

paragraphs.en: Record the present subcomponents in the task, e.g. one task may have all three whereas another may only have 1.
paragraphs.zh: 记录任务中现有的子组件，例如一个任务可能包含全部三个，而另一个可能只有 1 个。

paragraphs.en: Temporal sequencing counts when the order is instituted by the organization (such as other actors, schedules, policies, norms, or processes), even if the focal actor carries out all of the steps itself. A sequential order that arises only from the logic of the actor’s own steps, rather than the organization, does not count.
paragraphs.zh: 当时间顺序由组织（例如其他行动者、日程、政策、规范或流程）所规定时，即使用于焦点的行动者自己完成所有步骤，也计入时间排序。 仅由行动者自身步骤的逻辑产生、而非由组织产生的先后顺序，不计入。

sents.en: Temporal sequencing counts when the order is instituted by the organization (such as other actors, schedules, policies, norms, or processes), even if the focal actor carries out all of the steps itself.
sents.zh: 当时间顺序由组织（例如其他行动者、日程、政策、规范或流程）所规定时，即使用于焦点的行动者自己完成所有步骤，也计入时间排序。

sents.en: A sequential order that arises only from the logic of the actor’s own steps, rather than the organization, does not count.
sents.zh: 仅由行动者自身步骤的逻辑产生、而非由组织产生的先后顺序，不计入。

paragraphs.en: Time constraints count when they limit when the focal actor must act in the task, such as a deadline, a time window to act in, or an interruption embedded in the task. Dates in the supplied material or information that the actor works with, such as checking dates within a period or understanding whether offers are still active on a date, do not count.
paragraphs.zh: 当时间限制限定了核心智能体在任务中必须行动的时机时才计入，例如截止日期、可行动的时间窗口，或嵌入任务中的中断。 智能体所处理的给定材料或信息中的日期不计入，例如检查某段时间内的日期，或判断某报价在某日期是否仍然有效。

sents.en: Time constraints count when they limit when the focal actor must act in the task, such as a deadline, a time window to act in, or an interruption embedded in the task.
sents.zh: 当时间限制限定了核心智能体在任务中必须行动的时机时才计入，例如截止日期、可行动的时间窗口，或嵌入任务中的中断。

sents.en: Dates in the supplied material or information that the actor works with, such as checking dates within a period or understanding whether offers are still active on a date, do not count.
sents.zh: 智能体所处理的给定材料或信息中的日期不计入，例如检查某段时间内的日期，或判断某报价在某日期是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Recorded as: latency=present|absent; sequencing=present|absent; time_constraint=present|absent
paragraphs.zh: 记录为：latency=present|absent; sequencing=present|absent; time_constraint=present|absent

paragraphs.en: Definition: The alignment or divergence of actors’ objectives and the consequences attached to their actions, including rewards, penalties, performance measures, and other mechanisms that shape behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 定义：各行为主体目标的一致或分歧，以及与其行为相关联的后果，包括奖励、惩罚、绩效衡量以及其他塑造行为的机制。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents: Alignment (scale): aligned, divergent, or conflicting interests. Consequence-bearing (feature): whether the focal actor bears the consequences of their actions within the organization, such as rewards, penalties, or other mechanisms tied to performance measures.
paragraphs.zh: 子组件：一致性（尺度）：利益一致、分歧或冲突。 后果承担（特征）：焦点行动者是否在组织内承担其行为的后果，例如与绩效衡量挂钩的奖励、惩罚或其他机制。

sents.en: Subcomponents: Alignment (scale): aligned, divergent, or conflicting interests.
sents.zh: 子组件：一致性（尺度）：利益一致、分歧或冲突。

sents.en: Consequence-bearing (feature): whether the focal actor bears the consequences of their actions within the organization, such as rewards, penalties, or other mechanisms tied to performance measures.
sents.zh: 后果承担（特征）：焦点行动者是否在组织内承担其行为的后果，例如与绩效衡量挂钩的奖励、惩罚或其他机制。

paragraphs.en: Aligned interests are the baseline; only divergent or conflicting interests, or consequence-bearing, establish the dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 利益一致是基准；只有利益分歧或冲突，或产生后果影响，才构成该维度。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark’s score does not count as a consequence in itself; consequences count when they exist within the task environment (e.g., budgets, earnings, penalties), either accruing during the task (e.g., a budget drawn down or built up, penalties) or received at its end (e.g., a payout for completed work), even if they also enter the final score. Consequences that only count toward the overall benchmark score, without being embedded in the task, do not. Record which consequences are present (rewards, penalties, and other mechanisms) and the performance measures they are tied to.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试的分数本身不算作后果；后果只有在任务环境中实际存在（例如预算、收益、惩罚）时才计入，无论是在任务执行过程中累积（例如预算的消耗或积累、惩罚），还是在任务结束时获得（例如已完成工作的报酬），即使这些后果同时也计入最终分数。 仅计入基准测试总分、而未嵌入任务之中的后果则不算。 记录存在哪些后果（奖励、惩罚及其他机制），以及它们与哪些绩效衡量指标挂钩。

sents.en: The benchmark’s score does not count as a consequence in itself; consequences count when they exist within the task environment (e.g., budgets, earnings, penalties), either accruing during the task (e.g., a budget drawn down or built up, penalties) or received at its end (e.g., a payout for completed work), even if they also enter the final score.
sents.zh: 基准测试的分数本身不算作后果；后果只有在任务环境中实际存在（例如预算、收益、惩罚）时才计入，无论是在任务执行过程中累积（例如预算的消耗或积累、惩罚），还是在任务结束时获得（例如已完成工作的报酬），即使这些后果同时也计入最终分数。

sents.en: Consequences that only count toward the overall benchmark score, without being embedded in the task, do not.
sents.zh: 仅计入基准测试总分、而未嵌入任务之中的后果则不算。

sents.en: Record which consequences are present (rewards, penalties, and other mechanisms) and the performance measures they are tied to.
sents.zh: 记录存在哪些后果（奖励、惩罚及其他机制），以及它们与哪些绩效衡量指标挂钩。

paragraphs.en: Record alignment or consequence-bearing separately, where one can be present without the other.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐记录与承担后果应分别记录，二者可以单独存在。

paragraphs.en: Interests count when another agent (even if simulated) in the task, inside or outside the organization (such as a customer), pursues objectives that differ or conflict with those of the focal actor.
paragraphs.zh: 当任务中的另一个智能体（即使是模拟的），无论其处于组织内部还是外部（例如客户），所追求的目标与焦点行为者的目标不同或相冲突时，利益便会发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Persistence or difficulty in behavior does not in itself count as divergent or conflicting objectives. The other actor must want a different outcome, not just be unclear, slow or repetitive in reaching the same one.
paragraphs.zh: 行为上的坚持或困难本身并不构成分歧或冲突的目标。 另一个智能体必须想要不同的结果，而不仅仅是在实现同一结果时表现得不清楚、缓慢或重复。

sents.en: Persistence or difficulty in behavior does not in itself count as divergent or conflicting objectives.
sents.zh: 行为上的坚持或困难本身并不构成分歧或冲突的目标。

sents.en: The other actor must want a different outcome, not just be unclear, slow or repetitive in reaching the same one.
sents.zh: 另一个智能体必须想要不同的结果，而不仅仅是在实现同一结果时表现得不清楚、缓慢或重复。

paragraphs.en: Recorded as: alignment=aligned|divergent|conflicting|not_established; consequence_bearing=present|absent; consequences=<which rewards/penalties/mechanisms and the performance measures they are tied to, or none>
paragraphs.zh: 记录为：alignment=aligned|divergent|conflicting|not_established；consequence_bearing=present|absent；consequences=<涉及哪些奖励/惩罚/机制及其所关联的绩效指标，或为无>

paragraphs.en: Definition: The stability of the environmental conditions relevant to the task while work is underway.
paragraphs.zh: 定义：工作正在进行时，与任务相关的环境条件的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents: Object of change (feature): requirements, roles, resources, or conditions that the task rests on. Predictability of change (scale): predictable vs. unpredictable.
paragraphs.zh: 子组件：变更对象（特征）：任务所依赖的需求、角色、资源或条件。 变更的可预测性（规模）：可预测与不可预测。

sents.en: Subcomponents: Object of change (feature): requirements, roles, resources, or conditions that the task rests on.
sents.zh: 子组件：变更对象（特征）：任务所依赖的需求、角色、资源或条件。

sents.en: Predictability of change (scale): predictable vs. unpredictable.
sents.zh: 变更的可预测性（规模）：可预测与不可预测。

paragraphs.en: How knowledge is distributed at the outset is information structure; change during execution is dynamism.
paragraphs.zh: 知识在初始时如何分布是信息结构；执行过程中的变化是动态性。

paragraphs.en: The objects of change can be present and vary independently of each other.
paragraphs.zh: 变化的对象可以彼此独立地存在并发生改变。

paragraphs.en: Any change in an object of change establishes the dimension, even when predictable; predictability is recorded but does not decide whether the dimension is present.
paragraphs.zh: 任何变化对象中的任何变化都会确立该维度，即使该变化是可预测的；可预测性会被记录下来，但并不决定该维度是否存在。

paragraphs.en: Change must not result from the focal actor’s own actions. Changes to the actor itself, such as receiving a new task or a change in its role, count.
paragraphs.zh: 变化不得源于焦点智能体自身的行动。 智能体自身的变化也算数，例如接收到新任务或其角色发生改变。

sents.en: Change must not result from the focal actor’s own actions.
sents.zh: 变化不得源于焦点智能体自身的行动。

sents.en: Changes to the actor itself, such as receiving a new task or a change in its role, count.
sents.zh: 智能体自身的变化也算数，例如接收到新任务或其角色发生改变。

paragraphs.en: Recorded as: change=<one or more of requirements, roles, resources, conditions, or none>; predictability=predictable|unpredictable|not_established
paragraphs.zh: 记录为：change=<requirements、roles、resources、conditions、none 中的一项或多项>；predictability=predictable|unpredictable|not_established

paragraphs.en: First record whether the benchmark captures the dimension according to the definition (including subcomponents), and then record which subcomponents are present.
paragraphs.zh: 首先记录该基准测试是否根据定义（包括子成分）捕获该维度，然后记录存在哪些子成分。

paragraphs.en: Subcomponents are of two types: scale subcomponents record one value, or ”not established”; feature subcomponents record all that are present.
paragraphs.zh: 子组件分为两类：规模子组件记录一个值，或“未确立”；特征子组件记录所有存在的特征。

paragraphs.en: A dimension is established when a feature subcomponent is present or a scale subcomponent takes a non-baseline value. A dimension can also be present if it fits with the overall definition of the dimension without any of the subcomponents.
paragraphs.zh: 当某一特征子成分存在，或某一量表子成分取非基线值时，即确立该维度。 如果某一维度符合该维度的整体定义而无需任何子成分，该维度也可以成立。

sents.en: A dimension is established when a feature subcomponent is present or a scale subcomponent takes a non-baseline value.
sents.zh: 当某一特征子成分存在，或某一量表子成分取非基线值时，即确立该维度。

sents.en: A dimension can also be present if it fits with the overall definition of the dimension without any of the subcomponents.
sents.zh: 如果某一维度符合该维度的整体定义而无需任何子成分，该维度也可以成立。

paragraphs.en: Asked in the follow-up pass for each claimed or measured dimension. An item that combines several elements, such as information acquisition and reconciliation, is tagged as a single item.
paragraphs.zh: 在后续核查环节中针对每个声称或测量的维度进行询问。 将多个要素（如信息获取与核对）合并的项目标记为单个项目。

sents.en: Asked in the follow-up pass for each claimed or measured dimension.
sents.zh: 在后续核查环节中针对每个声称或测量的维度进行询问。

sents.en: An item that combines several elements, such as information acquisition and reconciliation, is tagged as a single item.
sents.zh: 将多个要素（如信息获取与核对）合并的项目标记为单个项目。

paragraphs.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Consistency of outputs (pooled); Synchronization (sequential); Mutual adjustment (reciprocal). Managing interdependencies through actions that are consistent, synchronized or mutually adjustable as work proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 协调需求（第2层）：输出一致性（汇集式）；同步（顺序式）；相互调适（互惠式）。 在工作推进过程中，通过一致的、同步的或可相互调适的行动来管理相互依赖关系。

sents.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Consistency of outputs (pooled); Synchronization (sequential); Mutual adjustment (reciprocal).
sents.zh: 协调需求（第2层）：输出一致性（汇集式）；同步（顺序式）；相互调适（互惠式）。

sents.en: Managing interdependencies through actions that are consistent, synchronized or mutually adjustable as work proceeds.
sents.zh: 在工作推进过程中，通过一致的、同步的或可相互调适的行动来管理相互依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Rules and standards (pooled); Plans and schedules (sequential); Direct communication (reciprocal). Managing different forms of interdependencies through standardization, planning, and communication.
paragraphs.zh: 治理机制（第三层）：规则与标准（汇集式）；计划与日程（顺序式）；直接沟通（互惠式）。 通过标准化、规划和沟通来管理不同形式的相互依赖关系。

sents.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Rules and standards (pooled); Plans and schedules (sequential); Direct communication (reciprocal).
sents.zh: 治理机制（第三层）：规则与标准（汇集式）；计划与日程（顺序式）；直接沟通（互惠式）。

sents.en: Managing different forms of interdependencies through standardization, planning, and communication.
sents.zh: 通过标准化、规划和沟通来管理不同形式的相互依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Consistent inputs (pooled); Timely and complete hand-offs (sequential); Successful adjustments (reciprocal). Successful navigation of dependencies, while satisfying required quality of focal output.
paragraphs.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：一致式输入（集约式）；及时且完整的交接（顺序式）；成功的调整（互惠式）。 在满足核心产出所需质量的前提下，成功处理各依赖关系。

sents.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Consistent inputs (pooled); Timely and complete hand-offs (sequential); Successful adjustments (reciprocal).
sents.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：一致式输入（集约式）；及时且完整的交接（顺序式）；成功的调整（互惠式）。

sents.en: Successful navigation of dependencies, while satisfying required quality of focal output.
sents.zh: 在满足核心产出所需质量的前提下，成功处理各依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Information acquisition and reconciliation. Obtaining fragmented pieces of information, reconciling potentially conflicting views and eliciting tacit knowledge inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 协调需求（第2层）：信息获取与调和。 获取碎片化的信息，调和可能相互冲突的观点，并挖掘隐性知识输入。

sents.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Information acquisition and reconciliation.
sents.zh: 协调需求（第2层）：信息获取与调和。

sents.en: Obtaining fragmented pieces of information, reconciling potentially conflicting views and eliciting tacit knowledge inputs.
sents.zh: 获取碎片化的信息，调和可能相互冲突的观点，并挖掘隐性知识输入。

paragraphs.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Information rules and standards. Structuring information distribution and codification through standard-setting and information systems.
paragraphs.zh: 治理机制（第3层）：信息规则与标准。 通过标准制定和信息系统来组织信息的分布与编码化。

sents.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Information rules and standards.
sents.zh: 治理机制（第3层）：信息规则与标准。

sents.en: Structuring information distribution and codification through standard-setting and information systems.
sents.zh: 通过标准制定和信息系统来组织信息的分布与编码化。

paragraphs.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Correct and complete information obtained; Contradictory information resolved. The acquisition and reconciliation of information, capturing its nuances to accurately represent the context.
paragraphs.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：获得正确且完整的信息；解决矛盾的信息。 信息的获取与核对，捕捉其细微差别以准确呈现上下文。

sents.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Correct and complete information obtained; Contradictory information resolved.
sents.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：获得正确且完整的信息；解决矛盾的信息。

sents.en: The acquisition and reconciliation of information, capturing its nuances to accurately represent the context.
sents.zh: 信息的获取与核对，捕捉其细微差别以准确呈现上下文。

paragraphs.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Routing and authorization. Routing decisions to actors with relevant decision rights, formally or in practice, and obtaining the necessary approval before proceeding.
paragraphs.zh: 协调需求（第二层）：路由与授权。 将决策路由给正式或实际上拥有相关决策权的参与方，并在推进之前获得必要的批准。

sents.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Routing and authorization.
sents.zh: 协调需求（第二层）：路由与授权。

sents.en: Routing decisions to actors with relevant decision rights, formally or in practice, and obtaining the necessary approval before proceeding.
sents.zh: 将决策路由给正式或实际上拥有相关决策权的参与方，并在推进之前获得必要的批准。

paragraphs.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Formalized decision rights. Allocating decision rights which facilitate approvals, delegation, escalation.
paragraphs.zh: 治理机制（第 3 层）：形式化的决策权。 分配决策权，以便于审批、授权与升级处理。

sents.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Formalized decision rights.
sents.zh: 治理机制（第 3 层）：形式化的决策权。

sents.en: Allocating decision rights which facilitate approvals, delegation, escalation.
sents.zh: 分配决策权，以便于审批、授权与升级处理。

paragraphs.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Necessary approvals obtained; Proper organizational conduct. Decision rights, confidentiality, and task ownership respected.
paragraphs.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：获得必要的批准；组织行为得当。 尊重决策权、保密性和任务归属权。

sents.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Necessary approvals obtained; Proper organizational conduct.
sents.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：获得必要的批准；组织行为得当。

sents.en: Decision rights, confidentiality, and task ownership respected.
sents.zh: 尊重决策权、保密性和任务归属权。

paragraphs.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Sequencing, waiting, and prioritization. Understanding the correct sequence in which tasks should be executed, waiting for inputs, and prioritizing certain tasks over others.
paragraphs.zh: 协调需求（第二层）：排序、等待与优先级设定。 理解任务应当执行的正确顺序、等待输入，并对某些任务赋予比其他任务更高的优先级。

sents.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Sequencing, waiting, and prioritization.
sents.zh: 协调需求（第二层）：排序、等待与优先级设定。

sents.en: Understanding the correct sequence in which tasks should be executed, waiting for inputs, and prioritizing certain tasks over others.
sents.zh: 理解任务应当执行的正确顺序、等待输入，并对某些任务赋予比其他任务更高的优先级。

paragraphs.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Planning and scheduling. Formalizing the schedule in which tasks should take place, when deadlines should be met, and in which order the tasks are prioritized.
paragraphs.zh: 治理机制（第3层）：规划与调度。 将任务应如何进行、何时应满足截止期限以及任务按何种优先顺序排列的调度形式化。

sents.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Planning and scheduling.
sents.zh: 治理机制（第3层）：规划与调度。

sents.en: Formalizing the schedule in which tasks should take place, when deadlines should be met, and in which order the tasks are prioritized.
sents.zh: 将任务应如何进行、何时应满足截止期限以及任务按何种优先顺序排列的调度形式化。

paragraphs.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Activities performed in required order; Deadlines and time windows satisfied. Output produced in correct temporal order with respect for sequencing, deadlines, and interruptions.
paragraphs.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：活动按要求的顺序执行；截止期限和时间窗口得到满足。 输出按正确的时间顺序产生，同时遵循顺序要求、截止期限和中断情况。

sents.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Activities performed in required order; Deadlines and time windows satisfied.
sents.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：活动按要求的顺序执行；截止期限和时间窗口得到满足。

sents.en: Output produced in correct temporal order with respect for sequencing, deadlines, and interruptions.
sents.zh: 输出按正确的时间顺序产生，同时遵循顺序要求、截止期限和中断情况。

paragraphs.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Alignment and negotiation. Securing the aligned participation of actors whose interests may diverge, partly through formal and informal negotiation.
paragraphs.zh: 协调需求（第2层）：对齐与协商。 通过正式与非正式的协商，部分地保障利益可能存在分歧的行动者实现一致参与。

sents.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Alignment and negotiation.
sents.zh: 协调需求（第2层）：对齐与协商。

sents.en: Securing the aligned participation of actors whose interests may diverge, partly through formal and informal negotiation.
sents.zh: 通过正式与非正式的协商，部分地保障利益可能存在分歧的行动者实现一致参与。

paragraphs.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Incentives and monitoring. Introducing incentives to align objectives of involved actors, alongside monitoring structures to mitigate agency problems.
paragraphs.zh: 治理机制（第 3 层）：激励与监督。 引入激励以协调相关参与方的目标，同时建立监督结构以缓解委托代理问题。

sents.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Incentives and monitoring.
sents.zh: 治理机制（第 3 层）：激励与监督。

sents.en: Introducing incentives to align objectives of involved actors, alongside monitoring structures to mitigate agency problems.
sents.zh: 引入激励以协调相关参与方的目标，同时建立监督结构以缓解委托代理问题。

paragraphs.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Cooperation of actors achieved; Divergent aims recognized and managed. Objectives of the involved actors successfully aligned with the focal task.
paragraphs.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：实现了参与者的协作；识别并管理了分歧的目标。 相关参与者的目标成功与焦点任务保持一致。

sents.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Cooperation of actors achieved; Divergent aims recognized and managed.
sents.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：实现了参与者的协作；识别并管理了分歧的目标。

sents.en: Objectives of the involved actors successfully aligned with the focal task.
sents.zh: 相关参与者的目标成功与焦点任务保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Anticipation and adaptation. Anticipating and adapting to changes in environmental conditions relevant to the task.
paragraphs.zh: 协调需求（第 2 层）：预测与适应。 预测并适应与任务相关的环境条件变化。

sents.en: Coordination requirement (Layer 2): Anticipation and adaptation.
sents.zh: 协调需求（第 2 层）：预测与适应。

sents.en: Anticipating and adapting to changes in environmental conditions relevant to the task.
sents.zh: 预测并适应与任务相关的环境条件变化。

paragraphs.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Dynamic planning and communication. Allowing for flexibility in tasks in order to continuously adapt, replan and communicate when environmental conditions change.
paragraphs.zh: 治理机制（第3层）：动态规划与沟通。 允许任务保持灵活性，以便在环境条件发生变化时持续适应、重新规划并进行沟通。

sents.en: Governance mechanism (Layer 3): Dynamic planning and communication.
sents.zh: 治理机制（第3层）：动态规划与沟通。

sents.en: Allowing for flexibility in tasks in order to continuously adapt, replan and communicate when environmental conditions change.
sents.zh: 允许任务保持灵活性，以便在环境条件发生变化时持续适应、重新规划并进行沟通。

paragraphs.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Plans and outputs adapted to emergent information; Changes in tasks successfully communicated. Output aligned with changes in environmental conditions, alongside successful communication to other involved actors.
paragraphs.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：计划与产出适应涌现的信息；任务变化得到成功沟通。 产出与环境条件的变化保持一致，并成功传达给其他相关参与者。

sents.en: Performance outcome (Layer 4): Plans and outputs adapted to emergent information; Changes in tasks successfully communicated.
sents.zh: 绩效结果（第4层）：计划与产出适应涌现的信息；任务变化得到成功沟通。

sents.en: Output aligned with changes in environmental conditions, alongside successful communication to other involved actors.
sents.zh: 产出与环境条件的变化保持一致，并成功传达给其他相关参与者。

paragraphs.en: You classify AI research papers from their title and abstract only. For each paper answer:
paragraphs.zh: 你仅根据标题和摘要对人工智能研究论文进行分类。对于每篇论文，请回答：

paragraphs.en: - is_benchmark: true only if introducing a new benchmark, evaluation dataset, evaluation environment, arena or test suite for evaluating AI models (LLMs, VLMs, foundation models or AI agents) is a PRIMARY contribution of the paper (typically signalled by naming the benchmark and describing it as the contribution). False for papers whose main contribution is a method, model, framework, analysis or training dataset, even if they also build a small evaluation set; false for papers that only use existing benchmarks or study humans.
paragraphs.zh: - is_benchmark：只有当引入一个新的基准、评估数据集、评估环境、竞技场或测试套件来评估 AI 模型（LLM、VLM、基础模型或 AI 智能体）是论文的主要贡献时才为 true（通常通过命名该基准并将其描述为贡献来表明）。 对于主要贡献是方法、模型、框架、分析或训练数据集的论文为 false，即使它们也构建了一个小型评估集；对于仅使用现有基准或研究人类的论文也为 false。

sents.en: - is_benchmark: true only if introducing a new benchmark, evaluation dataset, evaluation environment, arena or test suite for evaluating AI models (LLMs, VLMs, foundation models or AI agents) is a PRIMARY contribution of the paper (typically signalled by naming the benchmark and describing it as the contribution).
sents.zh: - is_benchmark：只有当引入一个新的基准、评估数据集、评估环境、竞技场或测试套件来评估 AI 模型（LLM、VLM、基础模型或 AI 智能体）是论文的主要贡献时才为 true（通常通过命名该基准并将其描述为贡献来表明）。

sents.en: False for papers whose main contribution is a method, model, framework, analysis or training dataset, even if they also build a small evaluation set; false for papers that only use existing benchmarks or study humans.
sents.zh: 对于主要贡献是方法、模型、框架、分析或训练数据集的论文为 false，即使它们也构建了一个小型评估集；对于仅使用现有基准或研究人类的论文也为 false。

paragraphs.en: - evaluates_agents: true if the benchmark evaluates AI agents that take actions over multiple steps in an environment (tools, web, OS, games, simulations, multi-turn interaction), false for single-turn question answering or classification.
paragraphs.zh: - evaluates_agents: 若基准测试评估的是在环境中跨多个步骤执行操作的 AI 智能体（工具、网页、操作系统、游戏、模拟、多轮交互），则为 true；若是单轮问答或分类任务，则为 false。

paragraphs.en: - game_based: true if the benchmark is built on games or game-like play (board, card, video, text adventure, social deduction, negotiation or economic games, game-theoretic interactions).
paragraphs.zh: - game_based: 若基准测试建立在游戏或类游戏玩法之上（棋盘游戏、卡牌游戏、电子游戏、文字冒险、社交推理、谈判或经济博弈、博弈论交互），则为 true。

paragraphs.en: - organizational: true if the benchmark explicitly places the agent in a workplace or organizational setting, or with other actors whose roles, decisions, information or interests matter (colleagues, customers, managers, other agents with their own goals).
paragraphs.zh: - organizational（组织性）：如果基准测试明确将智能体置于工作场所或组织环境中，或使其与其他角色、决策、信息或利益具有重要性的行为者（如同事、客户、经理、拥有各自目标的其他智能体）互动，则为 true。

paragraphs.en: Judge only from the text given. If the abstract is missing, judge from the title and be conservative. Return one row per paper, using the paper’s id exactly as given.
paragraphs.zh: 仅根据所给文本进行判断。 如果摘要缺失，则根据标题判断，并保持保守。 每篇论文返回一行，使用的论文 id 与所给完全一致。
